princess ramasi.name: Princess Ramasi
princess ramasi.origin: A spy for Imperial Japan during World War II, this woman posed as Princess Ramasi of India in the early days of 1944. Convincing a group of Indian Dacoits that she was the daughter of the goddess Kali, she intended to manipulate them into doing the bidding of the Imperial Japanese army. Her primary goal was preparing a massive rebellion across India in order to overthrow Allied forces and install the Japanese army. When this was discovered by the head of British-Indian Intelligence, the spy had him captured to be killed in a sacrifice later. She then plotted to target Viceroy Wavell as he arrived for a meeting with Indian officials. Part of this plan involved her pretending to be faint, causing a distraction for her minions to sneak into the facility and murder Wavell. When she pulled off this ruse, she was caught by Private Steve Rogers who carried her to a room next to Wavell's. She continued to act faint in order to cover for her men and found herself having feelings for Rogers due to his genuine concern for her well being. When her minions were spotted, she fled the scene after she learned they failed their mission by killing Wavell's secretary instead. When Captain America and Bucky tracked the Dacoits back to their temple, they arrived just as the spy was leading the Dacoits in the sacrifice of the intelligence agent. Captain America and Bucky came to the man's rescue and learned of the spy's plot. When they were cornered by "Kali", she recognized Captain America as Steve Rogers and gave him the choice to leave alive if he did not interfere with her plans. When Captain America refused, he grabbed the girl and used her as a human shield in order to try and get away. Convincing a group of Indian Dacoits that she was the daughter of the goddess Kali, she intended to manipulate them into doing the bidding of the Imperial Japanese army. Her primary goal was preparing a massive rebellion across India in order to overthrow Allied forces and install the Japanese army. When this was discovered by the head of British-Indian Intelligence, the spy had him captured to be killed in a sacrifice later. She then plotted to target Viceroy Wavell as he arrived for a meeting with Indian officials. Part of this plan involved her pretending to be faint, causing a distraction for her minions to sneak into the facility and murder Wavell. When she pulled off this ruse, she was caught by Private Steve Rogers who carried her to a room next to Wavell's. She continued to act faint in order to cover for her men and found herself having feelings for Rogers due to his genuine concern for her well being. When her minions were spotted, she fled the scene after she learned they failed their mission by killing Wavell's secretary instead. princess tonka.name: Princess Tonka
princess tonka.origin: In the 1940s, Princess Tonka's father King Bolo was the ruler of the Birdmen who lived on the planet Sunev. When Earth explorers Zephyr Jones and Corky Grogan arrived from Earth, it fulfilled the legends that the closely related planets would interact with each other. Zephyr and his comrade were welcomed with open arms by King Bolo, and they exchanged information and technology. During this time, Princess Tonka and Zephyr fell in love with each other. However, the jealous General Roudo, a spy for the evil Parrotmen, framed Zephyr and Corky as spying on the Birdmen. With no evidence to the contrary, King Bolo sentenced Zephyr and Corky to be executed the following day. However, the Parrotmen attacked before their sentence could be carried out. Princess Tonka helped Zephyr and Corky escape from their cell by bringing them their guns, and they fought back the invading Parrotmen and revealed Roudo as the traitor. Following Roudo's execution for his crimes, Zephyr and Corky returned to Earth, but not before Princess Tonka saw Zephyr off with a goodbye kiss.

prior turrin.name: Prior Turrin
prior turrin.first_appearance: Adventures of Cyclops and Phoenix Vol 1 2
prior turrin.origin: Little is known of Prior Turrin, before becoming a member of the Clan Rebellion. Roughly in the late 37th-early 39th century, Apocalypse ascended to power and ruled much of North America unchallenged, for 100 years, where humans and whoever else resistant to his rule could be killed at any moment. After Apocalypse destroyed the Clan Askani, a religious group of freedom fighters, Turrin joined the Clan Rebellion, an Askani-inspired team of freedom fighters. Turrin lived in Crestcoast and aided Slym, Redd, and Nathan Dayspring in entering the city. After the Clan Rebellion performed many many nocturnal raids, Turrin and Redd went on what should have been the final raid of Apocalypse's Citadel. Turrin's mind was fried by Ch'vayre, who said that he would aid Redd in stopping Apocalypse.

priscilla.name: Priscilla
priscilla.origin: Priscilla was the older sister of Carrie. After their parents died, the sisters lived together. Although Priscilla was the eldest sister, she was more carefree, so that Carrie had to take care of them both. Priscilla met Owen, the handsome son of a wealthy father, whom she immediately fell in love, and soon they were married and gave birth to daughter, Anna Marie. They lived in a back-to-nature hippie commune in Caldecott County, Mississippi. The commune's failed attempt to use Native American mysticism to reach the Far Banks. Priscilla was the only one of her commune, who managed to get into the Far Banks. Even after she died, she was able to leave in this reality her "echo". Years later "Priscilla" met with her daughter, and then disappeared.

priscilla dolly.name: Priscilla Dolly
priscilla dolly.origin: Priscilla Dolly was a housewife who lived in North Hollywood in a a traditional house completely decorated with numerous dolls. She was married to Nathan Dolly, secretly the super-villainous puppeteer known as Mister Doll. As a businessman, Dolly traveled all around the world and gifted his wife with dolls whenever he returned home. As time went by, their house became filled with the figures. In search for a magical totem to empower him with puppeteering abilities, Mr. Dolly met Django Maximoff in Mount Wundagore. Maximoff gave him a pair of macabre dolls, which could be animated with his essence. However, Mr. Dolly's life force was completely siphoned by the pair of toys, leaving his body lifeless. The dolls ended up being shipped to his wife. With the dread situation her husband faced, the insane Mrs. Dolly fashioned life-sized mannequins after the figurines, unwittingly imbuing them with portions of her late husband's spirit as well. She named the animated puppets Jacob and William, treating them as the sons she had never had with Nathan Dolly. She truly believed them to be their children, assuming her husband's spirit was contained exclusively in the original dolls. Under the dark identity of "Brother Grimm," the Dolly brothers secretly terrorized people in criminal activities. Mrs. Dolly decided to rent his former study in their house as a room for guests in order to make extra money. One of her tenants was Jonathan Drew for a period. At some point, she was approached by Mr. Magnus, who wanted to be the tenant on the room alongside his associate Spider-Woman. Coincidentally, Spider-Woman was the daughter of Jonathan Drew and investigated her father's murder. As such, Magnus and Spider-Woman moved in with Mrs. Dolly and her bizarre sons. Magnus mystically altered Mrs. Dolly's perceptions on Spider-Woman, who chemically caused females to feel disgust at her. Spider-Woman had run-ins with Brother Grimm, especially concerning her investigations on the death of her father and its connection to Congressman James Wyatt and to the fraudulent Pyro-Technics. Eventually, she found the original doll-size mannequins of Brother Grimm in one of Mrs. Dolly's drawers, raising suspicions. In retaliation, Mrs. Dolly captured Spider-Woman and her associate, Jerry Hunt. In a shocking revelation in her Revival Theater, Madame Doll appeared beyond Spider-Woman alongside the two Brothers Grimm. Madame Doll revealed her intentions of forcing Magnus to use his magical powers to revive Mister Doll. The vessel that would house her husband's essence was to be Hunt. Magnus pretended to assist in the ritual, but in fact he prepared Spider-Woman to interrupt it and save Hunt. The essence of Nathan Dolly dissipated as it was no longer linked to any matter. As a consequence, the Brothers Grimm reverted into lifeless mannequins again. Mrs. Dolly remained in desolation, having lost her entire family, both real and false. The insane Priscilla Dolly was taken into the Sunnyview Mental Hospital for care treatment, still living in delusion. She was visited by Magnus and Spider-Woman, since the latter regarded her as one of her few friends. Mrs. Dolly reportedly died shortly after. The legacy of Madame Doll lived on with Percy and Barton Grimes, who donned the outfits of the original Brothers Grimm.

However, she remained alive for years: In , Magnus is seen leaving Jessica Drew after Priscilla Dolly was hospitalized; and the next time he meets Drew in , Drew mentions it's been years since she had last met Magnus, and Mrs. Dolly is seen as alive because she is one of the people whose memory is explicitly altered to forget about Drew. However, Percy and Barton Grimes acquired the Playhouse Theater and became the second Brothers Grimm (in ) only months, not years, after the defeat of the original Brothers Grimm, per the Brothers Grimm's profiles in , and . This suggests that, when Drew says it's been years since she had last met Magnus, she may have been exaggerating. When Magnus demonstrated his magical powers by making flowers appear before Mrs. Dolly's eyes, she compared him to . This reference should be considered topical.
fields.trivia: Although Priscilla was favorably impressed at Magnus' magicks with the flowers and prompted him to find a job as a stage magician (not to mention that she had a professional interest in Magnus' sorcery at that point), she was uninterested in seeing him act once he got a job at the Hollywood Club, to the point of not remembering the name of the place.

priscilla ironwood.name: Priscilla Ironwood
priscilla ironwood.origin: Former romantic interest of Peter Parker; daughter of Daniel Ironwood. Born in Billings, Montana. Her first meeting with Peter has not been recorded in any story. Peter arrived late at the Daily Bugle's Christmas party due to a previous meeting with Cissy on that day. They were apparently dating for some time at this point. During a date, Peter and Cissy walked their way through Central Park. They were attacked by a werewolf (apparently a transformed Doctor Strange), and Peter tried to shield Cissy from his attacks. When Peter was thrown into a tree, Cissy thought that he was dead and she run away. She summoned a nearby police officer for help, but his bullets could not harm the werewolf. Cissy lost consciousness, but Peter recovered in time to rescue her from another attack. The two of them fell into a lake, and the werewolf soon fled on his own. Peter transported Cissy to Roosevelt Hospital, where she was diagnosed with a mild concussion. Peter was told that she would need weeks of rest to recover. In her hospital bed, the sleeping Cissy was dreaming about her encounter with the werewolf. She did not wake up while Spider-Man and the transformed Doctor Strange were fighting each other within her hospital room. After defeating Strange, Spidey kissed the sleeping beauty. Cissy did not wake up at the sense of someone kissing her, possibly too sedated to feel anything. Spider-Man was preparing for another date with Cissy, but he was nearly broke after paying his income taxes. He was planning to buy her "a big mac and fries", hoping that she would tolerate his money problems. Spidey skipped the date anyway, due to getting accidentally involved in Arcade's latest plot. Spidey tried calling the X-Men to explain that Arcade had already kidnapped Cyclops and Colleen Wing. Peter and Cissy jointly attended the Empire State University's technology science exhibit, and met the celebrity guest, Beast. Peter was frustrated that the sexy mutant was surrounded by female admirers, and told Cissy that he did not understand why women were attracted to the Beast. Cissy joined the other fangirls in trying to get her hands on the handsome mutant. She managed to get a piece of the Beast's torn shirt. She intended to keep it as a prized possession, alongside the guitar pick which she had taken from the musician Eric Clapton. When Peter walked Cissy back to her apartment, she was daydreaming about the Beast and she forgot to give Peter the expected goodnight kiss. Peter and Cissy attended a July 4th celebration together, and they then kissed outside her apartment. Cissy was certain by this point that Peter was quite unlike the shy bookworm described to her by other girls. She invited Peter to join her for a nightcap inside the apartment. Unfortunately for Cissy, Darkstar, Crimson Dynamo, and Vanguard were also present in the apartment. They were there to kidnap Cissy's father, but they soon kidnapped Cissy as well. The Crimson Dynamo knocked out Peter, but decided to leave the young man behind. Cissy was held captive by Nikolai Kutzov, the rogue agent currently in command of the trio of super-soldiers. Following a complicated conflict, Cissy's father was gunned down by Colonel Alexei Vazhin, due to his knowledge concerning anti-matter weapons being perceived as a threat to all life on Earth. The traumatized Cissy decided to move away following her father's death, ending her relationship with Peter.

fields.notes: Her last name was spelled "Ironwode" in Marvel Team-Up Vol 1 80, and "Ironwood" in both X-Men Vol 1 123 and Marvel Team-Up Annual Vol 1 2. The handbooks mostly use the "Ironwood" spelling. A minor character called "Cissy" makes a cameo appearance Marvel Team-Up Vol 1 70, barely avoiding a lethal attack by the Living Monolith. The Official Marvel Index to Marvel Team-Up Vol 1 4 identifies the character as Cissy Ironwood, but there is no indication that they are the same character. Chris Claremont wrote both the issues #70 and #80, and he seems to have just reused the name Cissy in both stories.

priscilla lyons.name: Priscilla Lyons
priscilla lyons.origin: Priscilla Lyons was in Kentucky hitchhiking to Miami, Florida when she was picked up by Jack Monroe — alias the costumed crime fighter "Nomad" — who was passing through on his motorcycle. Priscilla told Monroe that she was going to Miami to find her brother Phil, who she feared had become involved with dangerous criminals in the illegal drug trade. Monroe promised to find and rescue Phil for her. Monroe learned that Phil Lyons was in the employ of Ulysses X. Lugman, alias the Slug, the head Of Miami's illegal drug trade. Monroe managed to get a job working aboard Lugman's yacht and told Phil Lyons that Priscilla had sent him to bring him home. However, Phil said he was happy working for Lugman and did not want to be "rescued". Phil Lyons then informed his superiors about Monroe, injected him with a hypodermic needle containing drugs, and threw him overboard to drown. Concerned that she had not heard from Monroe in three weeks, Priscilla had contacted his occasional partner, the original Captain America, Steve Rogers. Rogers rescued Monroe from drowning, and together they battled the Slug and his men aboard the yacht. Nomad set the boat on fire, but he, Captain America, and the Slug all escaped. So too, apparently did Phil Lyons. Months later, Nomad and Priscilla Lyons arrived at the mansion owned by the former costumed wrestler Demolition-Man in the Santa Monica Mountains of California. Priscilla and Jack Monroe were now lovers, and she had adopted the masked identity of Vagabond. However, she had no special skills that would qualify her to be an effective adventurer or crime fighter, rather, she seemed merely to be tagging along with her lover on his adventures. Steve Rogers, the original Captain America, had temporarily abandoned that particular costumed identity. For a time Rogers, calling himself simply the Captain, worked alongside Nomad, Demolition-Man, and another crime fighter, the Falcon. The Captain insisted that Vagabond refrain from active participation in the team's battles against criminals. However, Demolition-Man began training Vagabond in hand-to-hand combat and gymnastics. When the Captain and his allies dealt with a breakout from the superhuman criminal detention center The Vault, Vagabond was ordered to remain in the team's van. Despite this, she proved able to persuade one of the escapees, Armadillo, to turn himself in. To her own astonishment, on another occasion Vagabond even succeeded in defeating the Black Racer, a member of the Serpent Society, by tickling her into helplessness. Nomad grew jealous and angry over the amount of time that Vagabond spent with Demolition-Man, although in actuality Vagabond and Demolition-Man were no more than platonic friends. Yet, Monroe refused to believe this, and the relationship between Jack Monroe and Priscilla Lyons came to an end. Priscilla went to see Curtiss Jackson, the head of Power Broker, Inc., in the hope of receiving his treatment to gain superhuman strength so that she could become more effective as a costumed adventurer. While she was speaking with Jackson, he came under attack from a costumed vigilantes known as Scourge. Hoping to gain enough strength to defend himself from Scourge, Jackson submitted himself to the strength enhancement treatment, knowing full well that in fifty percent of the cases it had terrible side effects. The treatment enlarged Jackson's musculature to such an extent that he was no longer able to move. Jackson was taken into custody by the police and placed in the Los Angeles County Hospital. Priscilla Lyons was then captured by Dr. Karl Malus, Jackson's chief scientist. Malus intended to take over the operations of Power Broker, Inc., but the safe containing Jackson's most important files could only be opened through the use of his fingerprints. Hence, since he believed that Jackson would trust Lyons, Malus gave her an "epidermold" made of a malleable putty-like material and demanded that she take an impression of Jackson's hand. Malus warned her that if she refused or betrayed him, he would have her brutally injured by some of his superhumanly strong henchmen. Malus placed a bracelet on her arm that she could not remove and through which he could monitor what she said. Guilt-ridden at the idea of betraying the faith of the now helpless Jackson, Lyons nonetheless went to his hospital room and took the impression of his hand. She then contacted Malus, demanding that he meet her alone in the hospital lobby with the key to the bracelet. Malus agreed, but on meeting her tried to inject her with a hypodermic needle whose contents were unknown. Lyons knocked Malus unconscious, injected him with the needle, put the bracelet on him, left him in a stall in the ladies' room, and had hospital security notified that he was there. She left the hospital, and phoned the costumed adventurer known as the U.S. Agent to tell him where to pick up Malus's henchmen. She then crushed the putty-like ball with Jackson's hand-print, ren

priscilla morrison.name: Priscilla Morrison
priscilla morrison.origin: Coming from a prosperous family, Priscilla Morrison nevertheless turned to a life of crime, becoming a drug dealer, along with her boyfriend Tommy. However, their activities brought them to the attention of three former World War II superheroes turned vigilantes, Crimson Commando, Super Sabre, and Stonewall, who captured and then hunted down criminals in Adirondack State Park for sport, and to help rid society of undesirables. The trio first hunted down and killed Tommy, while Priscilla was kept prisoner in the cellar of their hunting lodge. While Priscilla was still a prisoner, the trio also captured the X-Man Storm, suspecting her of being a looter, though actually she had been investigating an arson when they captured her. The trio of ex-heroes released Storm and Priscilla into the wilderness at the same time, with Storm pointing out she was not a criminal, though she knew they would not release her, knowing what she knew. The two women were given a head start, with the more skilled and fit Storm keeping them safe, although she disapproved of Priscilla's crimes. When Storm rigged up a trap to kill Super Sabre, however, the morally corrupt Priscilla was disgusted that Storm decided at the last moment not to use it. Coming upon some campers in an RV, Priscilla killed them and took their handgun, threatening to kill Storm with it. Priscilla was killed, however, by the Crimson Commando before she could.

prisoner zeta 987 349.name: Prisoner Zeta 987-349
prisoner zeta 987 349.origin: Prisoner Zeta 987-349 was a Broodling of Sleazeworld and an inmate at the Ravenstarr Maximum-Security Prison Galaxy of the Shi'ar Empire. He had been convinced of being a Brood and was sentenced to life imprisonment at Stellar-Block Q. When the Starbrand selected Ravenstarr inmate Suzanne Selby as its new host, it caused a powerful explosion that alerted the Shi'ar. A dreadnought was dispatched to investigate the explosion, but only one of its escape pods returned with two crewmembers. Prisoner Zeta 987-349 had stowed away on the escape pod, and was captured, but not before eating the faces off three Shi'ar guards. When Prisoner Zeta 987-349 was presented to Gladiator, he taunted him and spit on Gladiator's chest. In return, Gladiator used his power as Majestor to adjust the Brood's sentence to death, and killed him with a spit that pierced the inmate's skull.

prixat.name: Prixat
prixat.origin: Prixat is a mysterious entity known by many names whose voice was heard by few souls, living or dead. When Doctor Voodoo brought Quicksilver back to life following his demise at the hands of the Shredded Man, Prixat called him out for cheating death but let him get away with it, affirming he now owed him for doing so. Some time later, when Daniel Drumm returned to New Orleans accompanied by the Hand and started digging up graves looking for someone or something buried there, Prixat asked Doctor Voodoo to track him down in order to pay their debt.

priya aggarwal.name: Priya Aggarwal
priya aggarwal.origin: Priya Aggarwal was the daughter of Indian immigrants who was born and raised in Queens, New York. She worked part-time for her uncle in his souvenir shop, NYC Gift, in Times Square in Midtown Manhattan. She was desperate to fit in with cool kids at her school, even though they exhibited racist and inconsiderate behavior toward her. She did not want other people, including her parents, to know about her exceptional intelligence and interest in botany because she was afraid of the pressure that would bring. Her brother, Mohinder, committed suicide due to untreated anxiety and depression, and she worried that the same thing might happen to her. ===Becoming a Member of G.I.R.L.=== Priya first met Nadia when she arrived at NYC Gift in an attempt to recruit Priya to G.I.R.L.. Priya was uninterested, given her desire to fit in and worry about being like her brother. While Priya was speaking with Nadia, the store was attacked by Poundcakes and Priya's mother, Vandana, was held hostage. Nadia stepped in and defeated Poundcakes and her accomplice, Letha, with the assistance of Jarvis. After seeing Nadia help her mother while her own friends stood by, Priya decided to give G.I.R.L. a try. Priya's first call to action as part of G.I.R.L. occurred when Nadia called the group together to assist in removing a bomb from Ying's skull. Priya found the Horton Cells used to make the Vision's skin and applied it to the Vision Gloves which the group used to remove the bomb from Ying's head. Priya attended the opening of G.I.R.L.'s new facilities at Pym Labs, where Janet Van Dyne presented her with a work space and living quarters when she needed them. At some point, Priya also set up her own greenhouse within the lab. ===Early Research and Attack by A.I.M.=== Priya began studying plants and particularly communication between plants. During the attack by A.I.M., an unknown assailant impersonated Priya, leaving her unconscious in the green house. While Priya was in the green house, the assailant also pumped it full of an experimental gas Priya had been working with. Nadia and the others discovered and recovered Priya after an unspecified length of time; meanwhile, the person disguised as Priya made a getaway with the rest of A.I.M., after being spotted by Janet and Mockingbird. Priya made a full recovery and seemingly had no identifiable early side effects from the gas. When she returned to the lab late that night, Priya and her lab mates discovered Nadia in the midst of a manic episode. When Nadia fled into her microscopic lab, the other girls gave up, but Priya stole the original Wasp's Suit from a display case and used it to follow Nadia into the Microverse. Within the lab, Priya discovered Nadia in the depths of a depression, having realized what she had done to her other friends, and understanding that she had likely inherited bipolar disorder from her father, Hank Pym. Nadia expressed a desire to harm herself, leading Priya to explain her own brother's history with mental illness and his eventual suicide. Priya refused to allow Nadia to give up, saying that she was more important than she realized. At this point, Priya's suit began to malfunction and Nadia was forced to leave the lab and return to the macro world in order to save Priya. left|240px|thumb ===Gaining Superpowers=== Some time later, Priya sent an emergency text summoning Nadia to her house in Jackson Heights when she discovered that the plants there were responding to her mental commands, even in her dreams. Priya expressed that she did not want to be a hero, and that all she had ever wanted was to be normal, though when she compared her life with Nadia's, it didn't seem so bad. Priya later attended Nadia's birthday party, where she met and became friends with Ms. Marvel upon discovering that Ms. Marvel's parents had also been immigrants and that both their grandparents had lived in the same city, thus Priya began to reconsider her own potential to be a hero. At the G.I.R.L. Expo, Priya demonstrated that she was able to cause different forms of plants to communicate through the use of genetic alteration. Priya is also able to talk to vines, which she uses to save herself from A.I.M. attackers and gain Nadia entrance into the main hall. Though Priya is quickly captured by Seeker, she saves several of both her friends and enemies with her powers when Shay's portal is destroyed. In the days after the attack on the G.I.R.L. Expo, Priya expressed interest in becoming a superhero, and begins training with Finesse to better defend herself and control her powers.

pro.name: Pro
pro.origin: The Pro was a well-established assassin, known to his clients only as a PIN number. The Pro incapacitated the entire security force of Mr. Stanislaw at his Long Island estate, cornered him in his office, and ordered him to shut down his operations and flee the country. He left him alive, as he wasn't paid to kill him. Leaving Stanislaw's estate, he received a new target from Doctor Octopus: Jason Tso. That evening, he tasered two of Tso's employees, Lenny and Carlo, behind Tso's Club Noir. Attaching magstats to the back of their heads, he sent them in with guns, grenades, and orders to kill Tso. When they were stopped by Tso's employee Ben Reilly, the Pro interceded himself, breaking into Tso's safe room. Once there, he knocked out Tso's bodyguard Orlando Kannor and held Tso at gunpoint while he contacted Octopus, who wanted to watch Tso die. Before he could pull the trigger, the Scarlet Spider broke in, prompting Octopus to double the Pro's fee if he offed the Spider. Convincing her to triple it, the Pro attacked, only to be webbed up and dangled out the window. Unwilling to give up his fee, the Pro tossed a grenade into the room, escaping while the Spider rescued Bugle reporters Ken Ellis and Angela Yin. Fulfilling his contract, the Pro shot and killed Tso while he was engaged in battle with Dr. Octopus' forces.

pro rata.name: Pro-Rata
pro rata.origin: Pro-Rata was a magician who used accounting skills in order to command his magic. He hoped to obtain the Gem-Key that, once used at midnight with his Cosmic Calculator, would allow him to become a god. Posting an ad for an artist's model, he captured Beverly Switzler and kept her a prisoner in his tower built from credit cards on the Cuyahoga River in Cleveland. When Howard the Duck stumbled on them, Pro-Rata sent Howard and Beverly to another dimension to collect the Gem-Key. After retrieving the key, they were transported back to Earth, along with the Bahndbird. When Pro-Rata commanded Howard to give him the key, Howard tossed it off the tower, where it was caught by Spider-Man, who had been drawn to the tower when its upper levels were blasted open by the Bahndbird. As Spider-Man battled the Bahndbird, Pro-Rata attempted to blast him with a mystic bolt, but Howard threw his scabbard at the mystic, causing him to misfire and ignite the pollutants in the Cuyahoga River instead. In an act of heroism, Howard then knocked himself and Pro-Rata over the edge; however, Howard was saved by Spider-Man, and Pro-Rata landed in the fire to apparently perish alone. Pro-Rata survived this encounter, returning to face Howard the Duck again and recover the Gem-Key. In this second encounter, Pro-Rata turned Union Station into a fake movie studio.

prochaine sortie.name: Prochaine Sortie
prochaine sortie.origin: Prochaine Sortie was member of France's black ops team known as the Le Bureau Discret who found their teammate Anaïs "dead" in the Montmartre hilltop-borough of northern Paris. Trying to determine the cause of death they brought in their specialist, Le Necrogateur to telepathically read her last memories. thumb|left|Prochaine Sortie vs Fantomex. But Prochaine and the group were ambushed by the mutant team X-Force before learning Anaïs was only hit with a suspended animation bullet that simulated death. The main target was Necrogateur himself, and X-Force body-slided out of there while leaving the team and Prochaine out cold.

proctidae.name: Proctidae
proctidae.origin: Proctidae is the ex-wife of Opistho is an officer in Atlantis' military posted in Latveria, and they have had a child together, Crosta. During their divorce, she managed to obtain the custody of Crosta, as the judge thought that a military camp wasn't a right place for a child. When Namor's order that all Atlantean's join sleeper cells in human society, she didn't obey, as Crosta developed mutant abilities. Proctidae kept them secret, unwilling to let the army take her son and turn him as a weapon. After Opistho discovered that his ex-wife had disobeyed, Proctidae brought the affair to the attention of their King Namor in order to keep the boy, as Opistho engaged a paternity suit, to regain custody of their child, and let him join the army. professor circus of crime.name: Professor (Circus of Crime)
professor circus of crime.origin: The Professor was the "makeup wizard" for the Circus of Crime, one of their support staff responsible for makeup, costumes, hairstyling, etc. When She-Hulk was hypnotized and inducted into the Circus by the Ringmaster, the Professor -- using a massive amount of makeup to cover her green skin as well as dyeing and styling her hair -- disguised her as the Circus's new "female strong man", Glamazonia. However, jealousy among the Circus's regular performers towards She-Hulk caused the Professor to stage a near accident with a runaway circus wagon, although even in her hypnotized state She-Hulk easily dealt with it and was never in real danger. The Professor confessed all the same after She-Hulk broke free of the Ringmaster's control and arrested the entire gang. Whether or not the Ringmaster kept the Professor around after this betrayal is unknown.

professor briggs.name: Professor Briggs
professor briggs.origin: Professor Briggs hired Captain Kane to hep find Doctor Parker who went missing ten years ago using a map Briggs had. After reaching latitude X, Captain Kane's boat was sunk by what he thought was an island. After him and Captain Kane washed up on the island they were captured by the natives and taken to the same place as Doctor Parker who they had also tied up. After explaining his research with Growth Hormones,the giant snapping turtle known as Experiment 247 appeared out of the jungle. After escaping the island, they discovered the Doctor's first experiment,Experiment XYZ was an even larger turtle and was the "island" that sunk Captain Kane's boat.

professor buffanoff.name: Professor Buffanoff
professor buffanoff.origin: Professor Buffanoff was a brilliant scientist who was active in the 1950s, until some evil influence came over his mind. He secretly loved a woman named Ellen Carstairs. These demonic like creatures invaded his mind, their exact origin is unexplained but they claim to be his creations. He created a device to allow the creatures out of his mind and grow inside to wipe out all life on Earth. He covered this up by claiming he invented a device that could transport someone to the so called "third dimension". He invited reporters to show off his invention, among those who came to cover the story was the love goddess Venus who was at the time working for Beauty Magazine. Deciding to investigate the device further to learn its benefits to mankind, Venus broke into Buffanoff's lab that night. Buffanoff caught her in the act and activated the device. Instead of transporting Venus to another dimension, the device apparently shrunk Venus and transported her into Buffanoff's mind where she was confronted by the creatures who live in his mind. As Buffanoff and his creatures explained their plot, but Venus managed to convince Buffanoff to stop his insane plot to save Ellen's life. Buffanoff realized how mad the plot was and set off a chemical explosion that killed him. Instead of stopping the creatures Buffanoff's death released them. Venus then tricked the creatures to follow him to Olympus where the Olympian gods, with the assistance of the Asgardian thunder god Thor tried to fight off the creatures. These creatures proved to be too strong for the gods, so Venus tricked them into following her back to Earth and into the mind of Professor Buffanoff. As Buffanoff's brain died, the creatures died as well ending their threat. Venus then destroyed Buffanoff's device, believing that it was too dangerous for mankind to learn it's secrets.

professor cartwright.name: Professor Cartwright
professor cartwright.origin: ===Early Life=== In his early life, Professor Cartwright was a gifted teenager; however he despised his skinny physique, to the extent that he was even willing to trade his intellect for a physique like Captain America. ===Silent War=== Professor Cartwright was later seen in his senior-years, as the head scientist who was tasked with forcing Lord Gorgon to undergo Secondary-Terrigenesis, thus resulting in Gorgon's more animalistic appearance, and the breaking of the ventilation chamber, leading to Cartwright's exposure to Terrigenesis and his extremely muscular physique. Professor Cartwright began to formulate theories on the alteration of humans following Terrigenesis, whilst his body began to decay from his own exposure. He later returned the Terrigen Crystals to the Inhumans when they attacked the Pentagon, proclaiming the Crystals as cursed things. Cartwright then succumbed to the decay of his body.

professor chalis.name: Professor Chalis
professor chalis.origin: Professor Chalis was a scientist during the days of the American Frontier. He studied his practice in Chicago and was obsessed with turning men into giants. He studied Duval's theory on controlled cell growth using prismic light rays as the groundwork for creating a growth ray device. He tested the device out on a human subject named Zugg. The device worked, however as a side effect those exposed to the ray also lost their intelligence. Soon the scientific community learned of Chalis' experiments and denounced them. When meeting with his colleagues, Chalis refused to stop his work prompting his colleagues to contact the authorities. Chalis decided it was time to leave town, choosing to move to the American west where he could continue his experiments with little interference. When he arrived at his lab he found that Zugg had murdered two police officers who had been dispatched to confiscate his scientific equipment. Gathering what they could, the pair then fled the state and eventually settled in a manor outside of Leadville, Texas. There he continued his experiments for six months, and began romancing Marie Lathrop daughter of local rancher Jim Lathrop, much to the chagrin of local doctor Matthew Masters who was secretly the western hero known as the Black Rider. Chalis first began experimenting on animals, such as wolves and rattle snakes but eventually moved onto bulls, sending Zugg out to steal them from the Lathrop ranch. When the news of the missing bulls got out, Masters investigated as the Black Rider, following Zugg's foot prints to the Chalis mansion where he was attacked by an enlarged wolf, which he killed and then fled the scene. The following day, Professor Chalis invited Marie into his home to show off his work. When showing her his growth ray, Marie was frightened by the appearance of Zugg, causing her to accidentally turn on the device when she bumped into the activation lever. The ray struck Professor Chalis out, prompting Marie to get Doc Masters to look after him. Giving Chalis a clean bill of health, Masters and Marie left. However, Chalis was driven insane by the rays effects and he decided to experience the growth effect himself, but developed an antidote so he could reverse the effects later. He then began capturing ranch hands from the Lathrop ranch and experimenting on them as well. However one named Jim managed to escape. Now completely mad, Chalis also kidnapped Marie in front of her brother Bobby who rushed to tell Masters what happened. Master meanwhile had an encounter with Jim and realized what Chalis was up to. As the Black Rider, Masters stormed the Chalis mansion but was forced to face defeat at the hands of Zugg when Chalis put Marie in danger. The pair found themselves tied up and in the path of the growth ray. However, before Chalis could activate the device, Jim and the other giants revolted destroying the ray device in an explosion that killed Professor Chalis. In the aftermath, Black Rider's horse Satan freed his master and Marie, as well as slew Zugg. As the Chalis mansion burned down, the Black Rider administered the antidote to his surviving victims restoring them to normal, ending Chalis' insane experiments.

However, before Chalis could activate the device, Jim and the other giants revolted destroying the ray device in an explosion that killed Professor Chalis. In the aftermath, Black Rider's horse Satan freed his master and Marie, as well as slew Zugg. As the Chalis mansion burned down, the Black Rider administered the antidote to his surviving victims restoring them to normal, ending Chalis' insane experiments.
weaknesses: Obsessed with human growth to begin with, exposure to his own growth ray caused Chalis to go insane.

professor cobbwell.name: Professor Cobbwell
professor cobbwell.origin: Professor Cobbwell was the most famous electronics expert in town. He asked Mister Warren to recommend a student from Midtown High School who could help him with some research over the weekend, and he introduced him to Peter Parker. Doctor Cobbwell then asked Peter to run an errand to the Tinkerer Repair Shop, where he had left a radio to be fixed. However as it was discovered that Peter had stolen components from him (which he had intend to replace after using them to stop the Vulture) he would not allow Peter to continue assisting him.

professor crater.name: Professor Crater
professor crater.origin: Professor Crater was an important scientist working for America's space agency, a post which brought him to the attention of a frantic man who had found the remains of a crashed alien spaceship. After a quick examination of a logbook the man had recovered from the wreck, explaining that an alien spy was among them disguised as a human, Crater locked them both inside his office and pulled a gun on the man. At first, the man thought he had the impossible luck of having encountered the alien spy until Crater explained that the logbook's contents had been written in an indecipherable alien language which only the spy could have understood. As they were joined by armed military guards, the man shapeshifted back into his true, non-human form, bemoaning his ignominious fate.

professor dix.name: Professor Dix
professor dix.origin: Professor Dix was an expert archaeologist of the Mayan culture. When he managed to enter a Mayan pyramid, he was captured by a Nazi spy who pretended to be a Mayan priest with the intention of awakening the ancient robotic statue to then incite the local population against the United States. To obtain the collaboration of Professor Dix, the false priest who passed himself off as the Man in the Steel Mask, captured the Professor's daughter and under threat against his daughter forced him to translate the Mayan codes (this convinced the Professor of the fact that he could not be a Mayan priest) who made the statue awaken. The Nazi plot was stifled by the intervention of Captain America and Bucky who destroyed the robotic statue and captured the Nazi.

professor donaire.name: Professor Donaire
professor donaire.origin: thumb|left|Donaire's brain Professor Donaire was an elderly scientist seeking a means to prolong his life. Setting up a lab in Fiery Mountain -- a mountain so named due to the fact it was illuminated by cosmic rays from space -- to conduct experiments to implant his brain into a new body. He kidnapped a series of young and vital men for his experiments. However those who did not muster his scrutiny had their heads bashed open and bodies dumped outside of his mountain estate. His activities attracted the attention of the Angel, whose superb physique made him an ideal candidate for Donaire's transplant. Luring the hero into his castle, he attempted to have his hunch-backed minion Karlos attempt to knock the hero out. Avoiding this, the Angel confronted Donaire and learned of his plot. With his most recent victims enthralled, Donaire ordered them to attack the Angel. The Angel was able to fight them off and a frustrated Donaire attempted to slay the Angel by tossing a vial of chemicals at him. The vial missed and caused a massive fire. Donaire's brain was caught in the blaze and he in desperation attempted to save it. As the Angel escaped, Donaire's hideout exploded, killing the mad scientist.

professor dorn.name: Professor Dorn
professor dorn.origin: Professor Dorn lived on a secluded property in a small town in the state of Oregon. There, he experimented on humans to create a race of amphibians. With the aid of his assistant Ramon Valerez and the beauteous Mona Lake (both mental institute escapees). He conducted his experiments in relative seclusion. When the Sub-Mariner would pass through the area on his way back to the Pacific Ocean, he was spotted by Dorn. Dorn, fearing that the Sub-Mariner would ruin his plans, fled, serving only to rouse the Atlantean monarch's curiosity. When Namor went to pay a visit on the doctor, he was tricked into letting his guard down when invited in by Mona. Dorn drugged food given to Namor and then dumped him a tank of water. When the Sub-Mariner revived, he was forced to fight Dorn's artificially created amphibious men (who were escaped convicts). Namor was beaten into submission, and Dorn then took his body to experiment on. Namor revived and fought his way free. In the ensuing clash, he knocked Professor Dorn away, sending him falling down a flight of stairs to a neck breaking death. Namor then fled the scene with Mona before one of Dorn's weapons could overload and explode, destroying his headquarters and killing his other minions.

professor fear.name: Professor Fear
professor fear.origin: Professor Fear was a Nazi scientist who was active during World War II. In the fall of 1943, he was located in the United States where he began constructing a sonic device that could shatter the sense of its victims, making them his loyal slaves. He hired a bunch of local crooks to steal the special motor needed to make the device operate. However, when a shootout happened during the robbery it attracted the attention of the Human Torch and Toro who attempted to capture the crooks. While one of the shooters was captured, two escaped, prompting the Human Torch to chase after them. When the motor was delivered and Fear learned of the Torch's involvement, he tested his device on his two hired thugs, leading to a complete success. Hearing the Torch snooping around his hideout, Professor Fear sent his pliant slaves to capture the hero. Succeeding, he attempted to use the device on the hero when Toro came crashing into the room. The young hero used his flame powers to destroy Professor Fear's device, and the Nazi scientist was easily defeated and turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

professor grimm.name: Professor Grimm
professor grimm.origin: Taking a vacation to the Swiss Alps, the Human Torch and Sun Girl were attacked by Professor Grimm who used a growth formula to enlarge a baby into the massive Borkor. The Torch and Sun Girl tracked Grimm back to his secret hideout and administered the cure to Borkor, restoring the baby to his normal size, but not before it went on a rampage and killed Professor Grimm. The Torch and Sun Girl then tracked down Borkor's biological parents and returned him to his family.

professor holz.name: Professor Holz
professor holz.origin: Professor Holz was a scientist for the Nazis during World War II. By the fall of 1942, he was stationed in a secret underwater base, where he used his scientific genius to develop a ray that transformed sea creatures into gigantic size. He then unleashed these creatures on unsuspecting American ships. The activity prompted the United States military to ask the Sub-Mariner for assistance. After saving a ship from a giant swordfish, Namor followed as its corpse was pulled back to Holz's underwater laboratory. When Namor confronted Holz, the scientist managed to immobilize Namor with a gas. However, the gas wore off sooner than Holz had planned, and Namor swam after an entire army of giant sea creatures sent to destroy all the boats in New York Harbor. Getting the creatures to chase him, Namor caused them to pile into Holz's underwater laboratory causing water to seep in. Water soon touched the electrical supply within causing a massive explosion that killed Holz and his fish army.

professor imam.name: Professor Imam
professor imam.origin: Not much has been revealed regarding the origin and history of Professor Imam. Presumably, he served as the Wizard Supreme for the dimension of the Squadron Supreme for many years, although he remained a recluse, refusing to involve himself in much of the Squadron's affairs, such as their Utopia Program. Instead, he claimed that much of his strength was spent and he must conserve what remained to train his successor in 443 years. He was confronted by the renegade Squadron member Nighthawk who was searching for allies to help him oppose the Squadron's Utopia Program, but Imam refused. He agreed, however, to send him to the "mainstream" Earth to search for allies there. When Nighthawk returned, Imam again helped him to search for other superhumans on their native Earth. Later, when the powerful Nth Man appeared in their dimension, Imam was one of the first to recognize its threat to existence. He alerted the Squadron and agreed to travel with them to confront the menace. However, when Imam tried to use his mystic power to directly communicate with the Nth Man, Imam suffered a heart attack from the strain and died. He was able to predict that Arcanna's son Benjamin Thomas Jones (Mysterium), was destined to become the next Sorcerer Supreme.

Presumably, he served as the Wizard Supreme for the dimension of the Squadron Supreme for many years, although he remained a recluse, refusing to involve himself in much of the Squadron's affairs, such as their Utopia Program. Instead, he claimed that much of his strength was spent and he must conserve what remained to train his successor in 443 years. He was confronted by the renegade Squadron member Nighthawk who was searching for allies to help him oppose the Squadron's Utopia Program, but Imam refused. He agreed, however, to send him to the "mainstream" Earth to search for allies there. When Nighthawk returned, Imam again helped him to search for other superhumans on their native Earth. Later, when the powerful Nth Man appeared in their dimension, Imam was one of the first to recognize its threat to existence. He alerted the Squadron and agreed to travel with them to confront the menace. However, when Imam tried to use his mystic power to directly communicate with the Nth Man, Imam suffered a heart attack from the strain and died. He was able to predict that Arcanna's son Benjamin Thomas Jones (Mysterium), was destined to become the next Sorcerer Supreme.

professor jack.name: Professor Jack
professor jack.origin: Professor Jack was a scientist who worked at NASA who attempted to sabotage the rocket program but was foiled by the Thing and the Human Torch. As Johnny was chosen to pilot the rocket, Professor Jack captured the Thing and revealed he had put a slow acting acid that would break down the capsule while on its mission. The Thing freed himself, while Johnny's capsule broke up on re-entry, but was able to save himself by flaming one. Professor Jack was captured by the Thing and presumably arrested.

professor jameson.name: Professor Jameson
professor jameson.origin: thumb|left|100px|Professor Jameson Professor Jameson was a professor of history who specialized in Egypt. While exploring the unearthed tombs in the area, he discovered an artifact known as the Laughing Sphinx, a necklace that contained a "sacred" lotion allowing him to commune with higher beings. Drinking some of the lotion, he believed he was transported to the realm of the demon known as Modebl and was told to be the demon's courtier. Able to transform into a beastial form, Jameson wore the shrouds of a mummy and called himself Karr. Returning to the United States, he would go out at night and slay government officials and military leaders in order to prepare for the coming of his master. By day, he would resume his civilian identity of meek Professor Jameson. His string of murders made the papers and sent Captain America and Bucky on his trail. In their first encounter with Karr, Captain America managed to rip the Laughing Sphinx necklace from Karr's body before the mummy managed to escape. The next day when -- as Steve Rogers -- he was locked in the guard house for sneaking out that night, he would send Bucky to have the hieroglyphics on the sphinx translated. Bucky happened to bring the translations to Professor Jameson, who was surprised to find the boy had a copy of the writing on the sphinx, telling the boy that the Laughing Sphinx was they key and to bring it to him. Bucky did come back with Captain America after hearing from one of his friends that Professor Jameson was an expert on the Egyptian demon known as Modleb. Fearing that the professor was in danger, the two heroes arrived at the museum where they clashed once more with Karr. The mummy once more escaped, and during the fight, the Laughing Sphinx was snapped open to reveal a vial of fluid and a note telling those who drank the fluid and they would see what they wished to see. Captain America did just that and clashed with Modleb, however he dismissed the battle as nothing more a hallucination, believing the fluid to be an opiate of some sort. They then rushed to Professor Jameson's office where they were shocked to witness Jameson transform into Karr and attack them. During the final fight, Captain America knocked out Karr with a single punch and turned him over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

fields.notes: Captain America made a number of deductions regarding the nature of Professor Jameson, under the admission that he was no expert. He believed that the liquid he consumed was a hallucinogenic opiate that mass quantities could cause insanity. He made this assessment in 1943 at a point in his career where most of his brushes with the "supernatural" were usually hoaxes, unlike his later day encounters with actual demons, spirits, and gods. Further, sudden madness, insanity, or murderous impulses from consumption of opiates seems to stem from the lack of understanding and anti-drug propaganda of the time as opposed to any solid scientific knowledge of the drug and its effects. Secondly, Captain America suggested that Jameson transformed into his bestial form due to a form of lycanthropy. Although the full extent of his powers is unexplored, Jameson at least did not display any of the physical or transformative traits commonly associated with the affliction. It would seem more likely that Jameson really encounter Modleb and was granted his abilities from that demon.

professor jurg.name: Professor Jurg
professor jurg.origin: Professor Jurg was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. Posing as a botanist, he relocated to Pasta Guerrera, a small port town in South America which the American military sent supply ships. By the summer of 1943, he had become known as a friendly man who invited American sailors to his home for supper in gratitude to their effort in the war. There, he would convince them to ship plants from his greenhouse to Europe under the pretense that they were being shipped to a colleague in Europe who was expecting them. In reality, the plants were really a means of smuggling incendiary devices aboard the ships. Once the ships were at sea the devices would go off, causing a fire that would ultimately cause the ammunition stores to explode, sinking the ship, and killing the entire crew. With no evidence of attack, the American Navy were stumped at determining the cause of explosion. After the fourth such sinking reach the newspapers, the Sub-Mariner offered his aid in solving the mystery. Finding the "friendly" Professor Jurg suspicious, he followed the botanist home and overheard him tell his plans to his fellow spies. Attempting to stop them, the Sub-Mariner was knocked out and locked up in the dungeon in the basement of Jurg's home. After Jurg had sent his latest batch of American sailors away with his plants, he and his men then beat the Sub-Mariner within an inch of his life. Thinking Namor to be dead, Jurg ordered his men to dump the body into the ocean. This proved to be Jurg's undoing as the water revived the Sub-Mariner who tossed the plants off the supply ship before they could go off and then returned to Jurg's home and rounded the spy and his minions up, locking them in the dungeon to be collected by the authorities later. Jurg's subsequent fate is unknown.

professor kilgory.name: Professor Kilgory
professor kilgory.origin: Professor Kilgory was a puppeteer and thief who was active in the Atlantic City area during the 1940s. In 1945, he had a fairly popular puppet show in the area, his most popular attraction being Percy the Puppet. Unknown to all, Percy was not really a puppet but a man with dwarfism that helped Kilgory commit his crimes. One night, they murdered a wealthy woman staying at a hotel to steal her jewels. Percy gained entrance and escape through the woman's window. Staying in the hotel, the Human Torch and Toro, who came to the woman's room after hearing her scream. Thinking that the killer escaped to the roof, the Human Torch and Toro went there and were knocked out by Professor Kilgory. Waking up, the Torch and Toro heard a man scream and found that the murdered man was in the room directly above the woman's room. When Kilgory entered the room and asked the Torch what he can do, the Torch told Kilgory to call the police. Instead, Kilgory returned to his room and began packing his things in an attempt to flee. Having suspected Kilgory, the Torch and Toro attacked him and fended off both Kilgory and Percy and then turn them over to the police.

professor lin.name: Professor Lin
professor lin.species: Human descended from the Xian Fu Xi
professor lin.origin: Professor Lin was an accomplished archeologist who was on an expedition in Quianfengou when he came across several grave robbers. Despite his best efforts to stop them, the grave robbers detonated the area, breaking the chains containing the skull of Chiyou, which unleashed the god's spirit in the form of a red cloud. The explosion also unearthed the Sword of Fu Xi; unbeknownst to him, the professor was a descendant of Fu Xi and the Sword moved on its own to protect him from Chiyou's spirit and pointed out Chiyou's Spirit Orb, which was also unearthed. The professor fled the tomb and took the Sword to his youngest son Lie in Shanghai. The professor returned to the tomb with his eldest son Feng and built a puzzle box from the red wooden chains to contain the Orb, which pacified Chiyou's spirit. The professor and Feng were not heard from for a year, prompting Lie to search for them with the Sword as the superhero Sword Master.

professor marko.name: Professor Marko
professor marko.origin: Professor Marko was a brilliant scientist who was active during the 1950s. His only daughter, Stella, was confined to a wheelchair and the fact that his daughter could not enjoy life like normal girls eventually drove him mad. By 1954, he had financial backing from a communist spy named Gorodok who helped fund Professor Marko's mad scheme to get revenge against the world. Marko built a massive vacuum that sucked the air out of the Earth's atmosphere threatening to kill all life on Earth except himself, his daughter, and Gorodok who were safe in his lab. The Professor had a mad idea that with everyone else on Earth dead, his daughter could be queen of the entire planet. While Gorodok's motivations were unknown, as he had operatives in the city, he likely plotted to betray Marko after his mad scheme was finished. However, Professor Marko wanted the world to suffer slowly, this gave enough time for the Human Torch and Toro to learn of Marko's plot from two of Gorodok's men and locate the Professor's lab. Sucked into the vacuum, the two had their flames doused and were taken prisoner. The Torch and Toro were then placed in glass cylinders to prevent them from flaming on. However, Stella refused to be a part of her father's insane plan and helped free the heroes. When Gorodok attempted to escape, the Torch tried to stop him, causing the spy to fall from the lab's dome and suffer fatal injuries. Before Gorodok died from these injuries, he fatally shot the Professor. thumb|left|147px|Professor Marko's oxygen vacuum With the death of all life on Earth mere moments away, Stella miraculously was able to get out of her wheelchair and run to the reverse switch, but the Torch beat her to it, reversing the oxygen vacuum and saving the Earth. Although sad for the loss of her father, Stella was happy to be able to walk and live a normal life.

professor plaque.name: Professor Plaque
professor plaque.first_appearance: Heroes vs. Plaque: When Plaque Attacks! Vol 1 1
professor plaque.origin: When he was a child, the man who would become to be known as Professor Plaque was to afraid to go the dentist. This caused plaque to build up on his teeth and eventually decay, giving him great pain in the process. As an adult, he sought to have the rest of the world's children feel the same pain he felt, so he constructed a fear inducing machine to make them just as afraid dentist as he was. However, thanks to the efforts of Fantastic Four and Spider-Man, Plaque's plans never came to fruition and his machine was destroyed. The heroes then helped get Plaque proper dental care, alleviating his pain and leading him change his ways.

The heroes then helped get Plaque proper dental care, alleviating his pain and leading him change his ways.

professor rhinestone.name: Professor Rhinestone
professor rhinestone.origin: thumb|left|107px|Professor Rhinestone Professor Rhinestone was a scientist that operated out of the town of Middleton during the 1940s. For reasons of his own, he developed the criminal identity of the Fog, extorting coal mine owner Mr. Smythe into providing him with special fog coal that allowed him to create massive clouds of fog that made those exposed drowsy and slow-moving. Operating under these clouds of fog, the Fog and his henchmen committed a series of successful factory robberies in the spring of 1942. The Fog's success came to an end when the Defender and Rusty came to town on shore leave from their civilian identities as members of the United States Army. The pair of heroes learned the source of the fog from Rhinestone himself. Following the Fog's trail, they found him attempting to force Smythe into giving him more coal, strangling the man to death before the Defender and Rusty could stop him. Having all the coal in the city confiscated, the Fog made a desperate attempt to get it back by attacking the Defender directly. During their fight, the two fall off a pier into the water below and fought underwater. The Defender succeeded in unmasking the Fog and beat him in combat, leaving him to drown in the water.

professor rice.name: Professor Rice
professor rice.origin: Professor Rice was a world famous botanist who chartered a month-long expedition into the Belgian Congo to search for rare plants along with his daughter Mara. Unfortunately for them, their pilot was secretly Red Skelton, an international criminal. When Red exposed his identity, he demanded that Rice pay him a large sum of money and force Mara into marrying him in exchange for a safe trip home. Refusing to give in to extortion, Rice dove at the crook and was shot dead. Rice's daughter was rescued by Ka-Zar who later slew Red.

professor rodchenko.name: Professor Rodchenko
professor rodchenko.origin: Professor Rodchenko was a programmer for the Red Room in the 1970s, working on brainwashing, implanting cover identities into operatives before they would go on missions. He defected to the U.S. in the 1980s and worked for them until he was kidnapped by Leo Novokov, who threatened his family to force him to brainwash the Black Widow . He was also forced to create a program for the Winter Soldier to turn him back into an assassin. After Rodchenko programmed the Black Widow to think that she was still working for the Red Room, Novokov tied him up in his hideout, and Rodchenko was found and captured by S.H.I.E.L.D.. Thinking that it would help him find Black Widow, Winter Soldier implanted Rodchenko's programming into his head, and then used the same machine on Rodchenko so that he wouldn't be able to tell anyone else what was in the program.

professor svengalie.name: Professor Svengalie
professor svengalie.origin: Professor Svengalie was a mad scientist who was active in the 1940s. From his secret lab with his two assistants, he created six nearly indestructible robots in the fall of 1944 in order to take over the entire world. He unleashed the robots to attack Keystone Bridge as his first show of power. The bridge was demolished and hundreds were killed in the attack. The army responded to the attack in force but found that none of their weapons had effect on the robots. The Human Torch and Toro were called in to destroy the robots. When their flame powers also proved ineffectual against those, the pair followed the robots back to their creator's hideout. There, the Torch and Toro attempted to apprehend Svengalie but were incapacitated by an electric trap of Svengalie's creation. He then had the two heroes placed in a large glass bowl to suffocate. The Torch and Toro managed to break free, destroyed the control device of the robots, and cleaned up the professor's stooges. They confronted Svengalie, and during the fight, Svengalie doused Toro's flame with an alum bomb and then attempted to maim the boy with an axe. The Torch threw a fireball at Svengalie, causing him to reel backward and fall into his own atom smasher, killing him upon impact. The army applauded the heroes and Toro suggested that the robots should be donated to scrap drive.

professor tang.name: Professor Tang
professor tang.origin: Professor Tang was motivated by greed. When his wealthy wife listed her daughter Celia as the beneficiary of her will, Professor Tang put plans into motion to try and get the family fortune by any means possible. To this end, in 1935, he convinced his wife that she was crazy and had her locked in the attic, leaving everyone including her daughter to believe that she disappeared. With the aid of his butler, he kept the location of his wife hidden. Celia became more and more distraught over the years, but one day in the spring of 1943, Celia found her mother. Celia died that night, an apparent suicide, however it is more likely that Professor Tang had murdered her and made it look like a suicide. The death attracted the attention of newspaper reporters Jeff Mace, Mary Morgan, and Jack Casey. While Mary and Jack went off to get an interview with Tang, Jeff stayed behind to do his own independent research. Finding the circumstances around the Tang family fortune strange, he paid a visit to Tang's house and found that his friends had not yet arrived. Spotting a lipstick container on a table while Tang was trying to get him to leave, Jeff was knocked out and dumped in the cellar of the house to be dealt with later. Professor Tang then went up to the attic to shoot his wife dead. However, Jeff (as the Patriot) came to her aid and in the struggle with Tang, the gun was knocked free. Mrs. Tang then picked up the gun and shot her husband dead. The butler was soon knocked out as well and turned over to the authorities, thus ending Professor Tang's mad scheme.

professor tarbu.name: Professor Tarbu
professor tarbu.origin: Professor Tarbu was a fraud who worked as a fortune teller and medium during the 1940s. Like many such frauds of the era, he targeted the wealthy by using a projector to convince them that a deceased loved one was communicating with them from beyond the grave. Tarbu used this method to convince his victims that their deceased relative to entrust Tarbu with their fortunes to invest on their behalf. In the summer of 1944, Tarbu's intended victim was Mrs. Blaire, whose son Jimmy was killed in action during the war. Despite the warnings from her daughter Janet, Mrs. Blaire continued with her meeting with Tarbu and believed his hoax. Seeing her daughter as a hitch in his plans, Tarbu sent one of his men to deal with her. The henchman followed Jane to the office of the Human Torch and Toro and shot her as she explained what was going on. The shooter was chased by Toro but was run down by a car before he could be captured and forced to talk. Learning that the Torch and Toro were able to rush Jane to a hospital and save her life, Tarbu prepared a trap for them. When the two heroes came to his office to question him, they were quickly gassed. Tarbu and his men then placed them in a glass cylinder that would spin at sufficient speed to kill them. Before being locked in, Toro attempted to take a swipe at Tarbu but only succeeded in pulling the jewel off Tarbu's headdress. With the trap set into motion, the two heroes managed to break free by jamming its mechanisms with the gem and flaming their way out. Chasing after Tarbu, the frightened villain backed through a window trying to flee and fell to his death, the rest of his gang was then arrested and Mrs. Blaire's fortune recovered and returned to her.

professor todt.name: Professor Todt
professor todt.origin: Professor Todt was a member of the Nazis during World War II. In the spring of 1945 he and his men were assigned to blow up American docks, which was met with constant frustration due to the vigilance of the American forces stationed as guards. After a successful bombing, they then attempted to claim the bodies of victims at the morgue for the purposes of rigging their corpses with bombs and unleashing them into the oceans to blow up American ships. However at the morgue they had a run in with Private Steven Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes who learned for the mortician that they are he and his men claimed the most bodies than anyone else at the morgue. When the mortician failed to hand over his bodies, a fight broke out that Steve and James broke up. Todt fled, vowing to get his revenge. professor torture.name: Professor Torture
professor torture.origin: Nothing is known about the past of Professor Torture. At some point in his life, he lost his right hand and became obsessed with torturing individuals. Gathering a gang, he took over an abandoned prison ship hidden on the coast of Miami and stocked it with torture devices. He then began capturing members of Florida's wealthiest families in attempts to gather large ransoms for the safe return of these captured loved ones. More often than not, Professor Torture would kill his kidnap victims and dump their bodies in the ocean. His activities attracted the attention of the Angel who investigated the situation. The Angel would arrive too late to stop Professor Torture and his men from capturing Kevin Fitzmorgan, the son of the wealthiest family in Miami. The Angel tracked Professor Torture to his hideout where he too was captured. The Angel soon broke free, and in the scuffle against Professor Torture and his men, Torture himself was knocked onto the chopping block of a guillotine and was swiftly decapitated. Those members of his gang who weren't killed in the scuffle were bound up for the authorities.

professor wagstaff.name: Professor Wagstaff
professor wagstaff.origin: thumb|left|121px|Professor Wagstaff Professor Wagstaff was a drama teacher at the Lee School during the 1940s. He was obsessed with cavaliers of 17th Century France. In 1948 he learned that Patricia Walker was selling off her fathers most famous painting the "Masked Cavalier" in a charity auction for the Lee School's athletics department. He began training a gang of thieves on how to sword fight one Saturday afternoon in his classroom. This fighting was overheard by Fred Davis Jr. who mistook the practice as an attack and came to Wagstaff's "rescue" as Bucky. But the gang managed to escape before anyone could be captured. Wagstaff was later questioned by Captain America and Bucky but offered them no answers and played dumb about the attack. Dressing up as the Masked Cavalier, Wagstaff and his men broke into the Walker residence and attempted to steal the painting but were confronted by Captain America and Bucky. The Masked Cavalier attempted to escape out a window but was tackled and knocked out by Captain America. He was unmasked as Wagstaff, and Patricia revealed that the painting he attempted to steal was a fake. Wagstaff and his men were then turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

professor yates.name: Professor Yates
professor yates.origin: Professor Yates was in charge of the ancient cultures department at San Pedro University in Florida. His position there gave him the rare opportunity to examine the Golem, a sentient statue of Jewish myth. Shortly after his assistant Saudia Yamal determined the statue to be somehow alive, it later came under the control of an evil sorcerer named Kaballa. Kaballa was eventually stopped by the Golem with the help of the Fantastic Four's Thing.

professor zorsky.name: Professor Zorsky
professor zorsky.origin: thumb|left|183px|Zorsky's Living Dolls Professor Zorsky is a man steeped in mystery. In the 20th Century he was a performer in a travelling circus, he astonished audiences with his troupe of Living Dolls, which appeared mechanical devices but moved and spoke like a living person. The exact origins of these Dolls are unknown, but they appeared to be a chilling combination of both. His performance was seen one night by Beauty Magazine owner Whitney Hammnd, his editor Venus and photographer Reggie Smith. Impressed by the performance, Reggie snapped a photo earning the anger of Zorsky who kicked them out as he did not allow photos of his shows. Zorsky then followed them back to Beauty Magazine and stole the photos at gunpoint. This prompted Venus to go undercover and learn the secret of the Living Dolls. Disguising herself and using her love powers to get a job on the show, Venus tried to spy on Zorsky and his dolls. Caught, Venus was put under a hypnotic spell by Zorsky. Reggie returned to the show the following day he recognized Venus and that there was something wrong with her. Reggie then called Whitney who came running to Venus' rescue. A fight broke out between Whitney and Zorsky, which was joined by Venus who broke free from Zorksy's control. During the struggle, Zorsky's gun went off killing him. In the aftermath, Venus then attempted to open up one of Zorsky's dolls she was horrified to find it filled with blood. With Zorsky dead, the secret of his Living Dolls (which apparently went inert after his death) remains a mystery.

professor zunbar.name: Professor Zunbar
professor zunbar.origin: Professor Zunbar was a brilliant but mad scientist who was active in the 1950s. He was obsessed with creating life that would be able to breath underwater. His first attempt to do so was creating a creature he named Elmer, who, despite his aquatic features, was incapable of breathing under and was deathly afraid of water. The creature also developed an obsession with Zunbar's female assistant. In 1954, Zunbar came to believe that by transplanting the brain of the Sub-Mariner into Elmer's body he could gain success in his mad experiments. thumb|left|Elmer To this end, Zunbar sent a letter to the Sub-Mariner asking for his assistance, and when the hero showed up at his lab, Zunbar had his robots subdue and lock up the Atlantean monarch. Before the operation could be started, Namor's companion Betty Dean called the authorities and they stormed Zunbar's lab. During the confusion both Namor and Elmer escaped and after Namor destroyed the mad creature, he captured Zunbar and was apprehended by the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

proffet.name: Proffet
proffet.origin: During his sleep, Daimon Hellstrom met Proffet in an apparent dream. She offered to Daimon prophetic glimpses of his upcoming meeting with the god Anubis. But she also made taunting comments about the duality of Daimon's nature. Assuming that she is a new foe for him, Daimon attacked Proffet. She simply vanished, without trying to fight him. Daimon struggled to comprehend the complex plan of his new foe Mindstar, but he assumed that Proffet was involved in it. Proffet visited Daimon to inform him that she had nothing to do with Mindstar's attacks. But she offered no further explanation on what was going on. She claimed that this was part of her role. She could not provide answers, only questions. As Brett Carson started becoming a new pawn of Anubis, Proffet ominously claimed that she was weaving the tapestry of his fate. She commented on the visions which she was experiencing, and indicated that she was feigning ignorance about their meaning. During a conflict between Daimon and Mindstar, Proffet decided to intervene. She warped the perceptions of both opponents, while protecting Daimon from his foe's attacks. Proffet was soon struck down with a direct blast from Mindstar, but Daimon healed her with his powers. Proffet claimed that her prophetic visions and dreams had ended, and that she had become an ordinary human. She was uncertain about her own future, but she bid farewell to Daimon.

profile.name: Profile
profile.origin: The sons of the defunct criminal cartel known as the Committee re-established their organization and set about getting revenge against one of their former agents, Moon Knight. To that end, they hired a consultant known only as the Profile. The Profile reviewed the case history of Marc Spector and advised the Committee on the most efficient means of breaking him in body and spirit. The Committee members acted on the Profile's advice, but their poor strategic planning actually produced the exact opposite result. When Marc Spector resumed the mantle of Moon Knight, he destroyed the Committee's headquarters. The Profile went underground, but soon resurfaced when Moon Knight began searching for one of his old colleagues, Midnight. Under severe pressure, the Profile offered up a complete dossier on Midnight, and even advised Marc on how to improve his love life as well as helping him to essentially blackmail a man into getting him signed up for the Superhuman Registration Act in the way he wanted. When Moon Knight returned to New York City, Profile was enlisted by The Hood to help determine how to destroy him, but he had difficulty reading the new "Jake Lockley" persona. He asked The Hood to resurrect Bushman, but when Moon Knight chose not to kill Bushman, Profile traveled to Egypt where he finally understood as he knelt at the shrine of Khonshu. Some time later, Daredevil, possessed by The Beast, summoned Profile to find Moon Knight. To do that, Profile, knowing of Marc's pride in the role of Fist of Khonshu, tracked down and recruited down-on-his-life Randall Spector, Marc's brother, "appointing" him as the Moon Knight, saving him from suicide and getting him to try to usurp Marc's title.
