radha dastoor.name: Radha Dastoor
radha dastoor.origin: Born into a wealthy family in the midst of poverty-stricken Bombay, India, Haven spent her life surrounded by the dichotomy of her own family's wealth and the utter poverty of the people living in the streets around her. While her father was a Hindu and her mother was a Zoroastrian, they taught her all of the major religions, and encouraged her to embrace the prophets of these religions. When she became old enough to see the disparity around her, she began praying, seeking a way to rectify the glaring differences she saw. She eventually came to the conclusion that there were no differences, and that she would spend her life helping those in need. She earned the name Haven while helping the poor children in Calcutta. Eventually she met a man she felt she loved, and despite her upbringing, she gave into her passion. Though she genuinely loved the man, he grew weary of her and would later abandon her. Soon after this, she found she was pregnant. As the baby grew within her she began receiving messages of a rebirth the world would undergo called the Mahapralaya. An event that would see three-fourths of the world's population perish, but would ultimately result in a new breed of humanity rising up and taking control. As she was receiving these messages, she also began exhibiting the powers she would later utilize in her quest. Unwilling to wait for the Mahapralaya to happen on its own, she dedicated her organization to bringing about the disasters that would hasten the event. Her operatives actively incited political unrest, riots, revolts and even wars, as well as causing disasters like earthquakes, floods and plagues. When Forge ordered X-Factor to stop her, Polaris opposed the plan at first, having been saved from a government attack force by Haven. When X-Factor invaded her base, Val Cooper had become the newest convert to her movement. In order to further convince X-Force of her cause, she healed Wolfsbane of her imposed psychic bond with Havok, a remnant of her imprisonment on Genosha. Her organization was destroyed by X-Factor and Haven's brother Monsoon who had conspired with Val Cooper to bring down his sister. Dastoor later discovered that her child was actually the Adversary. She was killed after its birth.

radu dracula.name: Radu Dracula
radu dracula.origin: Radu Dracula was born in Transylvania (now Sighișoara, Romania), in the small European Kingdom of Wallachia. He was the son of Vlad Dracul (also called Vlad the Elder) and brother to Vlad Dracula. He accompanied his father and brother to the Ottoman Empire, where they planned to negotiate for peace. They were ambushed en route by agents of Sultan Murad II, who held the sons captive, forcing Vlad the Elder to favor Turkey. This eventually led John Hunyadi and Vlad's other advisers to revolt against him, killing him and his son Mircea. After five years of torture, Radu had died in captivity.

fields.notes: Radu Dracula is likely based on the real life person , younger brother to . In real life, he was never referred to as "Radu Dracula." The historical Radu had three terms as Voivode of Wallachia (reigned 1462-1473, 1473-1474, 1474). He was a political rival to his brother Vlad Tepes ("Dracula", son of the Dragon) as they both had legitimate claims to the Wallachian throne. Radu helped depose his brother Vlad in 1462, but they continued warring against each other for years. The historical Radu is known by the nicknames "Radu the Handsome" and "Radu the Beautiful", due to a reputation for irresistible beauty in his teenage years. He reportedly spend some time as a male concubine for Sultan Mehmed II, and managed to get Mehmed's support while seeking military appointments in the Ottoman Empire and claiming the throne of Wallachia. Radu disappears from the historical record c. 1475, after his final deposition. He is thought likely to have been murdered or executed by his political rival (and future son-in-law) Stephen III of Moldavia.

rafael carago.name: Rafael Carago
rafael carago.species: Mutant activated by the genetic bomb
rafael carago.origin: A villain calling himself Spidercide released an improved version of the Carrion Virus in Springdale, Pennsylvania, killing the entire population of the town. Spidercide and his master the Jackal later discovered that there was a single survivor. Rafael Carago was discovered by agents of the Center for Disease Control. Rafael's skin had hardened and darkened by the time CDC were able to sedate him, and he tore himself free and escaped. The New Warriors and the Scarlet Spider showed up, and beat Rafael into unconscious after he displayed his powers and attacked them. Rafael was then taken into custody by Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S., but Spidercide replaced the helicopter pilot, and escaped with Helix. The Jackal continued to experiment on a helpless Rafael, mutating him further while trying to discover how he resisted the Carrion Virus. The Jackal was unable to discover how Helix developed his powers either, and during a clone revolt in his labs, Helix escaped. During a battle in downtown Manhattan between a hallucinating Helix and the Warriors, the Scarlet Spider was able to wrap Helix in a web cocoon, and using his stinger dart launchers to inject Rafael with the same hypermorphic serum that knocked him unconscious in their earlier battle. The serum worked and Helix reverted to his normal form. The Scarlet Spider also realized that if nobody attacked Helix, his body would have nothing to adapt to, and would return to normal. The Warriors eventually released Helix from his containment in the Crash Pad, and he slowly gained their trust. It became clear that Helix was amnesiac, and only spoke Spanish. He formed a friendship with Mickey Musashi, Turbo, due to her college-level Spanish skills helping them to communicate. After a series of adventures alongside the Warriors, Helix haltingly said his goodbyes in English to Turbo, and promised to call if he needed help, then took off on a quest to find himself.

rafael scarfe.name: Rafael Scarfe
rafael scarfe.origin: ===Early Life=== left|thumb Rafael "Rafe" Scarfe was born and raised in New York City, when he was old enough he joined the United States Army and served in the Vietnam War. He served at the same time as Mitchell Tanner who became known as Warhawk. ===Misty Knight=== After his tour of duty he returned to the New York and joined the N.Y.P.D. and rose through the ranks quickly becoming a Lieutenant. He was partnered with a tough as nails cop Misty Knight. While visiting a bank with Misty, they encountered a bomb. She tried to get rid of it, but when it exploded it took her right arm. Rafe did his best to wrap her wounds and got her to the nearest hospital where he stayed by his partner's bedside. ===Iron Fist === Mitchell Tanner returned to the US with a severe case of PTSD, he still believed he was fighting in Vietnam and went on a killing spree on the streets of New York. He kidnapped Colleen Wing and was able to defeat Iron Fist. Because of this Professor Lee Wing contacted Rafe. Rafe revealed his past to Danny, and how he still believed he was fighting in the war. Iron Fist ignored his warning and went to rescue Colleen. At a charity softball game between the N.Y.P.D. and Marvel Comics, Rafe tried to convince Danny Rand to join his team to exploit his martial art skills. However after the game Rafe witnessed one of the spectators Princess Azir attack by the Monstroid. He ordered his men in to action, but the bullets were no effect and blasted Rafe and the teams. However Danny was able to destroy the creation using his Iron Fist. Rafe and Danny went to check on the Princess but when they arrived they are attacked by her bodyguard Khumbala Bey who nearly killed Danny. At the Wing's home they find the place ransacked and the professor was injured. They witnessed Colleen being dragged in the car by Master Khan's men dressed as police officers. When he questioned them, they shot at him and Danny saved his life. They followed them through New York in a high speed chase. However they were attacked by Angar the Screamer whose scream caused them to hallucinate. However Danny nearly killed Angar but was stopped by Rafe. Looking through he pockets they find a Stark id card. They interrogated Angar learning he was working with Tony Stark. He escaped using a scream to affect their memories. Danny infiltrated Stark Industries to find Colleen and teamed up with Misty in the process and exonerate Stark whose company had been infiltrated by Khan. Rafe got a lead from Interpol regarding the location of Khan. He argued the risks with Misty but she ignored him and followed the lead. Rafe has to deal with the Golden Tigers who were terrorizing the street of New York. John Byrne helped them with a sketch to identify the members of the gang. When Iron Fist was framed for the supposed murder of Bill Hao by the crime lord Chaka Khan, Scarfe decided to keep the fact that Hao was still alive a secret in order to use Iron Fist as bait to drive Chaka into the open. He figured it was better to risk a super hero's life than a policeman's. Rafe and Misty were called into the office of D.A. Blake Tower. He called them there as he wanted Misty to infiltrate Bushmaster's criminal organization. Rafe was against it as everyone who had gone undercover had wound up dead. ===Jean DeWolff=== He became partnered with Lt. Jean DeWolff, the duo try to break up a fight between Equinox and Spider-Man, Yellowjacket, and Wasp. The partners were called to the Baxter Building to find Spider-Man and the Human Torch fighting the Super Skrull. Spidey asked them for helping in distracting the alien, while he tried to take him out. The duo fired at him distracting him enough so Spidey could knock him into some generators, but it had no effect. They follow the Skrull out to sea in a helicopter where Spider-Man takes him out. ===Heroes for Hire=== He assisted Power Man and Iron Fist on numerous occasions. Scarfe often recommended caution to impulsive heroes like Luke Cage. Claire Temple treated Rafe when he was injured. Luke demanded that she gave him the best treatment possible, she took it as an insult. ===Daredevil=== Rafe's duties also put him into proximity and action with Daredevil. Now a Detective Rafe and the N.Y.P.D. arrived to apprehend the Jester. Daredevil found Jester's discarded costume, puts it on and masquerades as the Jester. He led cops on a wild goose chase, while the Jester finished his final performance on stage. Daredevil finally allowed himself to be caught and explains his motives. They the arrested the Jester for his real crimes. ===Master Khan=== After Iron Fist was killed in battle, Rafe was promoted to Captain. He visited Misty at hospital, who revealed she was attacked by a man resembling Iron Fist. He and Misty visited Danny's grave but when they opened it all they could find was rotting plants. It was revealed that Super-Skrull was disguised as Danny, but they were still convinced he must be alive. Tyrone King arrived to tell them

rafe michel.name: Rafe Michel
rafe michel.origin: Rafe Michel was a militant activist in Harlem. He was very concerned about equal rights for African Americans in the community. His views often put him conflict with the more moderate Falcon. Rafe further complicated the dynamic with the Falcon by having a relationship with the Falcon's romantic interest Leila Taylor. Despite their differences, Rafe and a group of concerned citizens helped rescue the Falcon when he was kidnapped and beaten by Captain America IV (50s Cap) and Jack Monroe. However, the Falcon and Rafe soon quarreled again over Leila. A frustrated Michel assembled his gang the "Silver Skulls" to beat the Falcon. However, the Falcon was able to defeat the gang, and Michel soon lost his prominence in the Harlem Community. Later, Rafe Michel was exposed to the ionic energy of Lucifer. Lucifer could not contain his energy on Earth's dimension in one human body and placed a portion of his essence in Rafe while placing another part in the second Aries. The two Lucifers soon came into conflict with Steve Rogers and the Falcon. Eventually, the energy from Lucifer could not be contained in Rafe Michel's body and he perished.

ragnar dwarf.name: Ragnar (Dwarf)
ragnar dwarf.origin: Ragnar was a Dwarf of Nidavellir who "took a turn toward the dark side". Needing the hottest possible fires for his forge, and having a liking for volcanoes, Ragnar established himself in the Popocatepétl Volcano, in Mexico. He was approached by Razan, lieutenant of Necrodamus, to transform Judas' Silver into an Angel-killing weapon in order to kill Michael during the Covenant, a diplomatic summit held every thousand years between Hell and Heaven. Quickly, Ragnar was very specific on the fact he needed all of Judas' Silver, at a moment where a sliver of it was in possession of Johnny Blaze, Daimon Hellstrom and Blade. He produced anyway a weapon, used by Necrodamus to kill Barachiel and other angels as a demonstration for Beleth, the emissary of the Infernal Armies of Hell. When Necrodamus still didn't returned the missing silver, Ragnar became less amicable and issued a clear statement: If he wanted the weapon, he had to bring the thirtieth piece of silver to him. The silver was soon brought back to Necrodamus, for Ragnar to complete the creation of the Archangel Killer. He was then visited by Johnny Blaze, Blade, Daimon, and Satana Hellstrom who tried to gather information by pretending to want to have a weapon made, then drifting the subject to his "latest project". Ragnar deducted the group's goals and attacked them, but was quickly subdued and convinced to give them the information they needed.

ragnarok.name: Ragnarok
ragnarok.origin: ===Origin=== Years ago when the Avengers first started, Iron Man found a strand of hair that had fallen from Thor's head. Tony kept the hair sample in case he might need it for later use. When the New Warriors attempted to gain ratings for their reality show by capturing a group of escaped supervillains, Nitro used his explosive powers which killed most of the New Warriors and children at a nearby school at a wide range. The government then proposed the Superhuman Registration Act to have all people with superhuman powers register with the government. When the Superhuman Registration Act became law, Tony knew that they would need some serious strength on their side and the time had come to use the strand of Thor's hair. Stark created a clone of Thor from the strand where he fused the clone DNA with Stark Industries technology. rahl.name: Rahl
rahl.origin: Rahl was one of those who rebelled against Umar. He was also a member of the rebel council who advised their leader, Clea. Rahl was part of the mission to secretly capture Umar's captain of the guard, Orini, by making it look like he had been killed by Mindless Ones due to the actions of a rebel who was willing to die to kill him. Rahl was with Clea when Synth arrived to report on how the mission from which she had just returned had gone wrong and only the intervention of an Outcast had prevented her group from being captured. When Rahl mentioned that having the support of the Outcasts might cause the rebellion to gain some powerful allies and wished they could contact the one who had aided Synth, that Outcast made his presence known and stated that he was there. Knowing that real Outcasts could not speak, Rahl realized he was an imposter and attacked with Bolts of Bedevilment but the intruder easily deflected them, then revealed himself to be Doctor Stephen Strange and stated that he had come to aid the rebellion. After returning with other rebels to their stronghold following a successful mission, Rahl was greeted by Burhn who addressed him as "brother." Later, Rahl was part of a rebel council meeting at which it was agreed that the rebellion was at an impasse and needed more information on Umar's troop movements before they could plan effectively. When Clea stated that she would try again to probe the mind of their prisoner, others pointed out that she hadn't had much luck in cracking Captain Orini's psychic shields and suggested that maybe she should let someone else try. When Strange asked if he might do the probe, Rahl immediately objected, saying that a matter of such importance should be handled by a member of the council. Rahl then agreed to Strange's suggestion that he be allowed to assist Rahl, and was present when Strange used the Eye of Agamotto to reveal all of the secrets that Orini had been hiding, including the fact that Umar was Clea's mother. Rahl was present when Strange revealed this shocking information to Clea and the rest of the council. Much later, Rahl and all the other rebels (except Clea) went on a most important mission to raid a caravan that was supposed to be secretly transporting power crystals. However, the caravan was a trap and all the rebels (except Strange) were captured in an ambush by a special squad of the royal guard. Sealed in encasement pods, they remained unconscious in Umar's dungeon until Strange and the real Outcasts freed them from the pods and revived them. While Clea battled Umar, Rahl, the other rebels, the Outcasts and Strange joined forces to repel an attack on a city by Mindless Ones that Umar had released. After Clea had been acclaimed as the new queen of the Dark Dimension and Strange had declined to be her consort, Rahl arrived to speak with her but apologized for coming at a bad time. However, Clea assured him that his timing was excellent. As they watched Strange leave for Earth, Rahl asked if he should come back later but Clea said that he should stay with her, just for a moment.

rahman bashara.name: Rahman Bashara
rahman bashara.origin: Dr. Rahman Bashara was a robotics engineer working for Baintronics. During the robot revolution, Bashara became apprehensive about oppressing artificial life-forms, since he believed they were not beneath humans. When a group of scavengers named the Midnight Wreckers raided a destroyed Robowerx factory in search for components, Rahman was outraged that robot security forces were dispatched to kill them. He disabled the robots from his computer, and then used a drone to follow the Midnight Wreckers back to their base. He then approached them and asked to join the A.I. Army, unaware that the Midnight Wreckers were not affiliated with them. Shortly afterwards, the Wreckers' base was attacked consecutively by the A.I. Army, and a group of Bain robots who had trailed Rahman since he had been ratted out by his coworker Lorna Hopgood. Hassle prepared to kill Bashara, believing him to be a spy, but Swift convinced her to give him a chance. Bashara jury-rigged a electrostatic amplifier to disable a couple of Bain-Robots, and then while Hassle covered him, he hacked the control module inside the head of one of the robots to knock them all offline. From Baintronics, Lorna was observing the attack, which was being commanded by security agent Dr. Cyclobe. She had become appalled that Cyclobe intended to kill Bashera and all the humans at the scene, so when Rahman hacked into his cyberlink with the robots, she caused Cyclobe's implants to meltdown, allowing Rahman to disable the Bain-Robots. After the A.I. Army soldiers were convinced by Ralphie that their attack was misguided, the Midnight Wreckers parted ways with Gears and left the hideout, with Bashara having joined their ranks under the alias of Brain. Having decided to take an active role in the robot revolution, the Midnight Wreckers attacked a top-secret Baintronics site. They found a robot torture chamber where Bain scientists were experimenting on ways to keep robots subservient by simulation of pain. Their robotic victims asked the Midnight Wreckers to put them out of their misery, and Brain became distressed that he couldn't save them. Hassle comforted him, and stayed behind as her teammates left to grant the robots their wish.

rahne sinclair.name: Rahne Sinclair
rahne sinclair.species: Mutant, mutated, and enhanced by Tier's Asgardian DNA
rahne sinclair.origin: ===Early Years=== Rahne Sinclair was born in the north highlands of Ullapool, Scotland and was delivered by Dr. Moira MacTaggert, who happened to live locally. Rahne's mother, a local sex worker, would never know her as she died in childbirth the night she was born. Her father was the local Presbyterian minister, Reverend Craig, who raised Rahne as an orphan without revealing that he was her father from an illicit relationship. Reverend Craig's treatment of Rahne during her first years was harsh, instilling a strict religious and ultra conservative moral code into her from a young age to compensate for his own lapse in character which led to her conception. 150px|thumb|right|Running from her village When Rahne first developed her mutant power of lycanthropy, she was mistaken for a werewolf. A group of terrified, religious locals believed that she had been possessed by the devil. Led by Reverend Craig, they chased Rahne across the Scottish highlands. At the end of the chase, Rahne fell unconscious and reverted to her naked human form at the feet of Dr. MacTaggert, who saved her from the mob. Doctor MacTaggert became a surrogate mother to the young mutant and took her under her protection, then took Rahne to America, to be schooled by Professor Charles Xavier. ===New Mutants=== Rahne soon became involved in a rescue mission to save the Professor from Donald Pierce, who was still affiliated with the Hellfire Club. With the help of Cannonball, Karma, Psyche, and Sunspot, the Professor was saved and he agreed to train the team of New Mutants. Although the team was originally created because the Professor was possessed by the Brood Queen egg inside of him for future embryos, they stayed together. During her time with the New Mutants, Rahne experienced many adventures, under the codename Wolfsbane. 150px|thumb|left|Young Rahne In the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, the New Mutants were tutored, by Professor X, and trained in the use of their powers, in the Danger Room. Due to her strict religious upbringing, Rahne found it hard to come to terms with some of her teammates habits. raidus.name: Raidus
raidus.origin: Raidus was a Micron from the Microverse and a member of a rogue group seeking to exploit the so-called Prometheus Pit to gain access to the Macroverse. He was among the beings responsible for orchestrating the escape of Carnage (Cletus Kasady), making a deal with him in exchange for access to a new universe filled with potential victims. Raidus and his allies guided Carnage to the portal and attempted to direct his actions toward their goals. During the conflict in the Microverse, Raidus was the only member of the original group to remain active after Carnage turned on the others. He later delivered both Carnage and Katy Kiernan to Marquis Radu, continuing to serve as an intermediary between factions.

rainbow spaceknight.name: Rainbow (Spaceknight)
rainbow spaceknight.origin: Little is known about Rainbow. She was one of the first generation Spaceknights that had returned to Galador prior to Rom's return and had been captured by Mentus and placed in stasis as a captive. Rom was able to free her upon his return to Galador along with a number of other fellow Spaceknights and with their help defeat Mentus and his servant Terminator. They were also able to subsequently prevent their homeworld from being devoured by Galactus by leading him to another world to consume. This was Wraithworld of the dreaded Dark Nebula that The Devourer or Worlds was unable to best. Galactus did keep his word and saved Galador by moving it in space to a location that was unknown to the Spaceknights. The stranded heroes then departed to their various assignments to continue their war against the Dire Wraiths. During a battle between various Spaceknights and Terrax the Tamer, Rainbow used her emotion-manipulation powers to make him lose his willingness to fight. This seemed to work well, but Rainbow pressed her lack when she tried to make Terrax feel pity for others. Terrax was not even familiar with that emotion as a concept, and he realized that these emotions were not his own. Angry with the "woman" who dared to toy with his emotions, Terrax swatted Rainbow out of the air and into the ground. When Terrax managed to reclaim his axe (which had been stolen by another Spaceknight), he ignored any other opponents to focus his attack entirely on Rainbow. She was mortally wounded with a blast of energy. With her last words, Rainbow instructed Starshine to avenge her death.

raisa chernekhov.name: Raisa Chernekhov
raisa chernekhov.origin: Raisa Chernekhov is a mutant from Russia. She received treatments and enhancements by the KGB when they were trying to develop a soviet super soldier. She, along with her husband, was able to abduct their taken child, Alef, and break out of the facility. She attacked Wolverine with her husband David when they thought he was hunting them for the reward money offered by KGB agent Tatiana Nemikova. While teaming up they were able to defeat Wolverine in a fight, leaving him for dead. She eventually befriended him and helped carry him to heal his wounds after being told by the forest people that Wolverine is to be trusted. Later her family move to New Zealand.

While trying to hit Ivanovich with a sniper shot, he missed when he saw Ivanovich's little daughter appear and only managed to wound him, so he went in pursuit and when he reached him he didn't want the little girl to see that he was killing her father and handed her over to the Black Widow, who had secretly followed the Winter Soldier, so that he would not see and at that point killed Ivanovich by stabbing him to death, while Natasha embraced Raissa not letting her see the murder.

raizo kodo.name: Raizo Kodo
raizo kodo.first_appearance: Tomb of Dracula Presents: Throne of Blood Vol 1 1
raizo kodo.origin: A warrior in medieval Japan, Raizo Kodo found his clan threatened by the warlord Jakkaru, a mysteriously powerful conqueror (and secretly a vampire) who had legions of men at his command, held in sway mostly by fear. Journeying to Jakkaru's encampment with his brother Ryuhei in the guise of simple peasants, the duo was able to infiltrate his camp, killing his guards and confronting Jakkaru. Enraged, Jakkaru attacked the pair, holding his own before being stabbed through the heart by Ryuhei. Thinking him dead, Ryuhei approached the body hoping to find a personal treasure of Jakkaru's he could show his father, but quickly found that Jakkaru wasn't dead. As Jakkaru sunk his fangs into Ryuhei, Raizo grabbed the first thing he could find, a wooden training sword, and stabbed Jakkaru again, then beheaded the vampire, seemingly killing him. Escaping with his injured brother, the two fled to their clan's home. left|thumb At home, the Lord Kodo's attendants attempted to warn him of the evil that lurked within Ryuhei, speculating that a demon had possessed Jakkaru and now resided in Ryuhei. Warning his father that maybe the attendant was right, Raizo's father ignored him, thinking Ryuhei just needed rest. Over the next few days, Ryuhei's behavior changed, as he spent nights carousing with women in the neighboring village. Confronting Ryuhei over this behavior, Raizo found his brother belligerent and angry that his brother seemingly didn't respect him. Feeling the need to do something to help his brother, Raizo met with Suzume, unofficially his fiance, who told him that if a problem existed, he needed to solve it. Determined to solve the mystery of his brother's odd behavior, he set to find the answers at Jakkaru's fortress. There, he found the former servants of Jakkaru, enraged at his presence, and swiftly dispatched them. Questioning their commander, Raizo was told the story of Jakkaru, who, after meeting with a Dutchman who promised him power and eternal life, found himself changed, and began carrying out "acts of unspeakable depravity." thumb|right|Dressed for battle Leaving Jakkaru's castle, Raizo returned home, stopping along the way to outfit himself for battle. Entering his home, he confronted his father, a newly-turned vampire. Slaying the old man and his mother, he then set fire to his home. When Suzume approached him, he attempted to convince her to leave with him, not realizing that Suzume had already been transformed. Bitten by Suzume, he found he had no choice, and was forced to kill her. Killing the other transformed residents of the Kodo clan, he eventually confronted Ryuhei who sat calmly in anticipation of the battle. Offering Raizo a chance to join the clan as it gained power, Raizo told his brother he would never choose that path, then battled his brother, eventually being disarmed and held at the point of a sword by Ryuhei. At that point, a piece of the burning roof fell onto Ryuhei, separating the two and setting Ryuhei on fire. Seeing his chance, Raizo beheaded his brother and fled the fire. Stopping at a nearby tree, Raizo knew, due to Suzume's bite, he would soon find himself corrupted as his family had become. Holding a wooden sword to his gut, he prepared to kill himself...but found himself too weak to do so. And as the change took effect, he found he liked who he had become. During World War II, Raizo opposed certain members of the Nazis known as the Thule Society as they experimented on vampires for mystical reasons. When the Valkyrie known as Brunnhilde arrived following her strange summoning to earth, she found the slaughtered Thule Society members, and after a brief fight following Raizo's assumption that she was one of their number, Raizo informed her of their acts and that the building they were in was set to explode. The two quickly left. In 1957, while living in Kenya he met Charles Xavier. Raizo saved Xavier from mercenaries, who were hunting for a group of Raizo's people. In gratitude for saving him, Xavier erased their memories. Now a vampire himself, Raizo found himself alone, and left with a lot of time. Feeling he was fated for some great purpose, he began training himself. Over the years, he joined the Krieger sect, a militaristic vampire army, learning their secrets before moving on to join the Claw sect, learning their talents before again moving on. Angered over this, a Claw sect envoy was sent to Dracula for permission to kill the vampire, which Dracula granted, knowing the Claw sect had no hope of killing the vampire. At an unknown point, Raizo founded his own clan of Vampires, known as the Forgiven. When Dracula's Romanian fortress came under assault by Nul, the Forgiven offered Dracula their services. Briefly imprisoned as a security concern, they easily broke free from their cell. While his teammates sought to protect the citizens of nearby Pasnic and prevent Nul from reaching Dracula's castle, Raizo spent his time considering the known information on Nul/Hulk, and t

rajah sarput.name: Rajah Sarput
rajah sarput.origin: Rajah Sarput was a notorious game hunter from India who purchased land in the Belgian Congo for the purposes of satisfying his need to hunt. Sarput was not below hunting even the native population of the area. Sarput's activities attracted the attention of Ka-Zar who sought to stop him from harming the animals and people that lived in his jungle. During his initial attack, Ka-Zar was injured by a bullet and his "brother" Zar the lion was captured by Sarput. Sarput intended to nurse Zar back to health and then hunt the powerful lion down. However, the game hunter named Bradley sought to purchase the lion from Sarput so that he could bring it to an American zoo. Sarput refused, but Bradley stole the animal in the night. Learning this, Ka-Zar went after his companion. When Ka-Zar and Zar returned from the United States, they learned that Sarput was massacring the animals of the jungle in their absence. Ka-Zar once again clashed with Sarput but was forced to flee when he broke his knife against Sarput's bulletproof vest. Returning in the night, Ka-Zar and his animal allies stormed Sarput's castle. While Ka-Zar set the place ablaze, Trajah the elephant slew Sarput, crushing his body with his trunk.

raki.name: Raki
raki.first_appearance: Rise of the Black Panther Vol 1 2
raki.origin: Raki was one of the handful of Wakandans abducted by the Atlantean scientist U-Man and General Zoruun of the Nigandan Army during a period of roughly a decade to perform studies on them. Due to the strange nature of their disappearance, then-King S'Yan decided to keep the incidents a secret from the public to avoid panic. When T'Challa succeeded S'Yan, he learned of these incidents and acted on them. He eventually located the base of the kidnappers in Niganda and shut down their operations with the help of the Atlantean king Namor. Raki and the other abductees were then brought back to Wakanda.

rakkhal.name: Rakkhal
rakkhal.origin: Rakkhal's father was an atomic researcher in a scientific center, in an age when atomic energy was all but abandoned in favor of magnetic energy. Not many were experienced with the ancient tech, and an accident altered the researcher's genes. Months later, when his wife announced that they were to have a child, he felt fear. The child was a mutant who grew rapidly. At four, he reached the dimensions and power of an adult, with a fury like no other. And when he reached maturity, his father understood that Rakkhal was unstoppable and invincible. Only his parents were capable of restraining him. Once they died, his savagery was unleashed. His home planet felt they had no choice but to destroy him, yet their attempt only succeeded in infuriating him, and convincing him that all who lived were his enemies. He began to destroy and conquer all in the universe, even the Earth and Zenn-La, creating a vast army of slaves who served him out of fear of death. Silver Surfer encountered him in an attempt to break the barrier Galactus had created over the Earth to prevent his former Herald from leaving the planet. By travelling at the speed of light, the Surfer was able to travel to the future where he discovered the universe had been devastated by the fury of Overlord. When even his best blows couldn't wound the Overlord, the Silver Surfer returned to the past, before the birth of Overlord, and destroyed the atomic pile his would-be father was working on. Thus the father's genes were never modified and the would-have-been-Overlord was born a normal boy who enjoyed a normal life.

By travelling at the speed of light, the Surfer was able to travel to the future where he discovered the universe had been devastated by the fury of Overlord. When even his best blows couldn't wound the Overlord, the Silver Surfer returned to the past, before the birth of Overlord, and destroyed the atomic pile his would-be father was working on. Thus the father's genes were never modified and the would-have-been-Overlord was born a normal boy who enjoyed a normal life.

raknar.name: Raknar
raknar.origin: Raknar was a corrupt imperial officer in the Shi'ar fleet. He attempted to murder a young Shi'ar girl known as Jandra who was a key witness when a high-ranking officer committed murder. She was rescued by the intergalactic pirates known as the Starjammers who then fled to Earth. Raknar pursued them and was eventually defeated by the X-Men. He was placed into custody and returned to the Shi'ar homeworld.

rakses.name: Rakses
rakses.origin: Rakses was a pharaoh and necromancer who, before dying, tried to conquer the world. He was brought back to life as a mummy by Fazil, using the Orb of Ra, who tried to enslave Rakses to do his bidding. However, he pronounced his name wrong and so Rakses was free to do as he pleased and killed Fazil. N'Kantu, the Living Mummy and monster-hunter Elsa Bloodstone arrived at the pyramid and fought Rakses. Rakses used the orb to summon the Demons of the Sands and a monstrous scarab to attack them, but N'Kantu managed to distract the necromancer long enough for Elsa to snatch the Orb. Upon his escape however, Rakses was beheaded by Adam.

raksor.name: Raksor
raksor.origin: ===Battle with Bel-Dann=== Raksor was a military officer and warlord of the Skrull Empire, sent to observe the trial of the Phoenix and her human host Jean Grey by the Shi'ar Empire. Charles Xavier, however, demanded a duel to decide her fate, leading to the Shi'ar empress Lilandra deciding to consult the Supreme Intelligence and R'Klll, the leaders of the Kree and the Skrull empires respectively, when Kree observer Bel-Dann objected to a trial by combat. The two leaders agreed as long as it was made sure the X-Men lost. For this purpose, they assigned both Bel-Dann and Raksor to observe together, much to the latter's chagrin. thumb|left|Impersonating Storm Not content on merely being an observer, Raksor impersonated Storm and tried to strangle Wolverine to ensure the X-Men lost, but was stopped. Bel-Dann however saved the Skrull observer and insulted him for letting his life be endangered, and stated that he would be dead without him. Raksor became incensed and proceeded to attack him, leading to a battle that continued for months in the bowels of the ruins of the Blue City as they were too evenly matched. They were stopped by Uatu the Watcher who showed them a message sent by their leaders. The two rulers stated that the latest phase of the Kree-Skrull War had exhausted both the empires. As a result, they had agreed to determine the victorious empire through a duel between Bel-Dann and Raksor, to which both warriors agreed. Uatu was chosen as the judge of the battle. Unknown to both warriors, the city of Attilan had been established by the Inhumans on the edge of the Blue City, while they had been busy fighting. During the wedding day of king Black Bolt and Medusa attended by the Fantastic Four, the warriors resumed their combat and were now outfitted with powerful weapons. Their fight beneath the Blue City destabilized Attilan's foundations, causing blue flames to erupt and making the House of Agon as well as the Fantastic Four investigate. Raksor attacked them after having discovered them and decided to eliminate them so Bel-Dann couldn't take advantage. Being successful against the Inhuman king and Medusa, he recognized who he was fighting after being attacked by Human Torch and Invisible Woman, deciding to flee rather than spend time in battling them. Retreating back to Attilan, Reed Richards planned out how to best deal with Raksor and Bel-Dann, both of whom they had separately fought, and got Uatu to cooperate with him. As Bel-Dann and Raksor engaged in combat, they neared the nuclear power plant of Attilan and inflicted heavy casualties on the Inhumans who tried to stop them, but were eventually forced to withdraw and confronted by the House of Avon as well as the Fantastic Four. As the two warriors started losing, they realized their only hope lay in an alliance. The Terrans pretended to lose and Uatu appeared afterwards, declaring both won by working together, which was the best solution for their empires. As he banished them both to their home, he told them to inform their empires about what happened. ===Skrull Civil War=== Raksor had been transported back to the Power Asteroid after his battle with Bel-Dann, and discovered that the Skrull throneworld Tarnax IV had been destroyed, while the empire itself was enduring a civil war. When Zabyk seized control of the facility, he hid himself and discovered the rogue Skrull reuniting with his old friend Myrn, who suggested using the Power Asteroid as a weapon of mass-destruction in order to ensure Zabyk's dream of changing the Skrull Empire came true. Raksor fled and tried contacting the Skrull Armada, but found they had sealed off the Base Planetoid. In order to stop Zabyk and Myrn, he decided to free prince Dezan who was their friend in past and had once plotted to change the ruthless nature of the Skrull Empire. Raksor infiltrated the Skrull prison planet of Klarr along with Baryn and another Skrull, disabling the alarms and interceptor beams. As the team fought past Klarr's defences, Raksor was the sole member to survive and was able to free Dezan. He told him why he had freed him and took him to the Big Casino spaceship run by a Skrull called "Floyd Donahue". Donahue, after meeting the Avengers and learning they were going to the Power Asteroid under permission from General Zedrao to track Nebula, took them to meet Dezan who explained their situation to them. Major Syrro, who had been accompanying the Avengers, meanwhile lambasted Raksor for freeing Dezan. Raksor in return explained why he had no choice but to free him. The Avengers agreed to help and infiltrated the Power Asteroid with Dezan using the Spirit of Coolidge spacecraft, but were unable to defuse the Hyperwave Bomb which nullified the Skrulls' shape-shifting abilities. ===Slaughter Squad=== thumb|right|As a member of the Slaughter Squad Raksor later joined the criminal Mister Knife's Slaughter Squad when Kl'rt became the Skrull emperor after a civil war between the various Skrull warl

ral dorn.name: Ral Dorn
ral dorn.origin: Ral Dorn was a human of Earthling parentage who leads the Dragon Riders of the extradimensional world of Rammatpolen. The Dragon Riders use dragons as mounts in their journeys through time and space. Ral Dorn trained from a young age to be able to ride dragons. He was accepted into the Dragon Riders but told he would not get a dragon. Wondering why, Ral went to the dragon pens and found all the dragons dead by poison. Others arriving at the scene assumed Ral did it so he ran away. left|thumb|When he came the first time on EarthHe was pursued by Dragon Lord Skagerackrakor, but fought him off, injuring the side of his face. He and his friend Lalique escaped to Earth so that he could find Dragon Man and make him his dragon steed. They went to where Dragon Man was made and found the Thing of the Fantastic Four, who sent him to a hospital. At the hospital, Lalique magically healed Dorn, but told him he now thought Ral was guilty of killing the dragons and left. Ral went to the Baxter Building to get help from the Fantastic Four, but was attacked by the Human Torch, who though Ral was an enemy. There Ral demonstrated his ability to absorb fire. Ral told the Fantastic Four his story and they agreed to help him. They found the Dragon Man and Ral formed a sympathetic bond with him, becoming his new rider. He went back to Rammatpolen to face the charges against him. There he faced Skagerackrakor in a trial by combat. Skagerackrakor tried to cheat by using a secret grenade, but ended up blowing up his own Dragonstaff. Ral won the fight and Skagerackrakor confessed to poisoning the dragons. He also confessed that he had unleashed all of Rammatpolen's dragons on Earth in order to destroy it. Ral Dorn, the Fantastic Four, and all the Dragon Riders succeeded in rounding up the dragons and bringing them back to Rammatpolen. Dorn was made the new Dragon Lord. Skagerackrakor's exile didn't last long. After escaping with a dragon named Dagonn, he started his quest for Dragonthorne's eggs, which would have allowed him to conquer the whole universe with an army of dragons; in order to do so, he stole Ral's Dragonstaff, but not before the Dragon Lord hid the eggs in the timestream. When Ral and Dragon Man arrived in what for them was the future, they had to fought Skagerackrakor (who started naming himself "Baron Skagerackrakor") and with the help of Deadpool and Wolverine the Dragon Lord was able to get his Staff back. They soon left the fight hiding wher Ral had hidden the eggs: Weirdworld, there Wade and Logan mistakenly fought the eggs's keeper, Crystar, until Ral explained the situation. All of them went to the eggs' hiding place, but they encountered a Swamp Serpent, and Dragon Lord tried to summon a dragon to save them, however, he summon the Hulk instead. However, the Dragon Lord used the magic of his Dragonstaff to unveil the eggs and to send the Hulk back on Earth, but at that point Ral and Deadpool had to fought the evil dragon Persillex who wanted the eggs for herself. After her defeat, Major X appeared as part of a mission to avoid his apocalyptic future. Major X's father, Cable explained that after Deadpool got Dragonthorne's eggs, he sold them and those were used by crime lords to create human-dragon hybrids, starting the Dragon Wars and leading to an universal conquest under Skagerackrakor's control; feeling responsable for what had happened (or what's going to happen), Ral Dorn joined Cable in their last battle against the Dragon Men. During the fight, Ral understood that the only way to end that was to reach the Baron on his dragon, Ghost-Spider helped him in doing what he wanted and the final fight began, with a stronger Skagerackrakor who's going to kill Ral, but Dorn was eventually able to killed his enemy using the Dragonstaff. All the energies of Skagerackrakor were absorbed by the Staff and then by Ral himself, making him the ultimate Dragon Lord. The Dragon Wars ended when all the dragons retired under Ral's control, and then Dorn returned his correct timeline with Deadpool and Wolverine.

ralf mutant.name: Ralf (Mutant)
ralf mutant.origin: Little is known about Ralf, save that he was a mutant youth somehow acquired by the evil Helena Carlson's DermaFree Corporation as an unwilling test subject and taken to the company's secret laboratory in Austria. In the lab, he and the other test subjects were kept sedated by the telepathic powers of another guinea pig, Sasha, and potentially-lethal tests performed on them in an attempt to discover cures for skin conditions. They were eventually freed by the shapeshifting spy Mystique, who had been sent by Professor X to infiltrate DermaFree and rescue any mutant test subjects. Mystique put the mutants up in a hotel, but, enraged over DermaFree's acquisition of her own genetic material, neglected to keep watch over them, and they were recaptured. Carlson gave the order to march them back to the lab and execute them, with graves being prepared for them ahead of time. However, the mutants overwhelmed the guards, with one of them reporting to Carlson that they had been killed. Following this, the group was reunited with Mystique.

ralph avery.name: Ralph Avery
ralph avery.origin: Ralph Avery was a scientist and a friend of Silvester Meek and Daisy Printwhistle. Initially skeptical of the supposed Midas potion described in an ancient book, Avery dismissed it as superstition. However, when Silvester developed the uncontrollable ability to turn objects into gold, Avery investigated the circumstances and discovered the presence of a mysterious alien mist that had caused the effect. By tracing the mist to an alien spacecraft and forcing the aliens to retreat, Avery ended their attempted invasion and restored Silvester to normal.

ralph bohner.name: Ralph Bohner
ralph bohner.origin: thumb|left|150px|As Quicksilver for Halloween Randall, known under his witness protection name Ralph Bohner, was a resident of Westview, New Jersey who lived right next to the plot of land that would have been 2800 Sherwood Drive. After Wanda Maximoff transformed Westview into an idyllic sitcom-like reality, it attracted the attention of the rival witch Agatha Harkness. She moved in to observe Wanda, choosing Ralph's house because of its proximity to Wanda's. Agatha used a magic necklace to place Ralph under mind control of her own, entirely separate from Wanda's. She then assumed the identity of Ralph's "wife" Agnes to build a relationship with Wanda. Later, Agatha "re-cast" Ralph to play the role of Wanda's late brother Pietro, using his "eyes and ears" to try and pry out Wanda's secret to no avail. During this time, Ralph also displayed the super speed powers of the real Pietro, presumably granted to him by Agatha's magic. He was eventually freed from Agatha's control when Monica Rambeau ripped off her necklace off him, allowing his true personality to resurface. After being freed from both Wanda and Agatha's influences following the collapse of the Hex, Ralph immediately left Westview (even leaving his Blu-Ray collection). During the following years, Ralph relocated near Paramus, New Jersey and began to adopt charms and practices to protect him from witches. While still pursuing his acting career and developing a one-man show, Ralph also shared his experience in the Hex online while other Westview citizens/Hex victims remained silent on the matter. In late 2026, Ralph's comments were discovered by Billy Maximoff (resurrected in the body of William Kaplan) who was trying to learn more about the Hex and the Scarlet Witch. The pair agreed to meet in-person where Billy learned about the Scarlet Witch's twins (Billy and Tommy), and Agatha Harkness.

fields.trivia: Evan Peters' portrayal of Ralph Bohner is a meta-reference to the fact that he had previously portrayed another version of Quicksilver in the X-Men films. Evan Peters and (the actors who portray the two Quicksilvers) worked together in the superhero movie Kick-Ass, which was based on a comic book by Icon, an imprint of Marvel Comics. During the first Halloween, Ralph's costume resembles the original uniform of Quicksilver in the comics. Ralph's surname "Bohner" is a direct reference to 's character Richard "Boner" Stabone on the sitcom , which WandaVision director Matt Shakman appeared on. In , Agatha (living in Ralph's home) was wearing a shirt (that presumably belonged to Ralph) for the Bohner Family Reunion depicting a tent and campfire in the woods with the slogan "Pitch a Tent!" In a deleted scene from , it was revealed that Ralph Bohner was Agent Woo's missing FBI informant. However, given his comments and appearance in , it seems unlikely that this is still canon.

ralph gornov.name: Ralph Gornov
ralph gornov.origin: Ralph, during a tourist tour in European caves discovers an underground city where the leader lies to him about their peaceful intent. He tells Ralph that he can't be allowed to leave so the surface world won't invade but Ralph desires to return to leave and promises not to reveal their existence. Ralph is allowed to roam the city but one room is forbidden to him. One day the guard leaves his post at the entrance to the tunnel leading to the surface and Ralph makes a break for it. They discover Ralph is missing but the leader is unconcerned as he thinks Ralph believes everything he told him about why they wish to remain undiscovered. The leader opens the door to the forbidden room which reveals a huge weapons cache they are building with which to attack the surface world.

ralph hutchins.name: Ralph Hutchins
ralph hutchins.species: Human Mutate by an injection of She-Hulk's blood.
ralph hutchins.origin: Ralph Hutchins worked with Doc on an experimental serum. They tricked She-Hulk into their lab to get her blood and perform experiments on her. Doc added her blood into serum, but when She-Hulk managed to get out of constraints, he injected the serum into Ralph and escaped. Ralph's body mutated and he transformed into Brute. After a short fight with She-Hulk his body was torn apart and he seemingly died. In truth, however, he survived, and his body continued to mutate and Doc continued to send him over and over again under different guises to fight with She-Hulk to test out his powers. He fought with her as Seeker, Radius, and Torque , but all of them were defeated. His mutation then turned him into Earth-Lord, capable to fuse itself with the ground and control it. He seemingly became strong enough to finally defeat She-Hulk, but another of Doc's experiments, Kyr, attacked and overwhelmed Earth-Lord to the point that he regressively mutated back through every form and eventually returned back to his original body. Regression helped him to get rid of Doc's control. Ralph allied with She-Hulk to defeat Doc. During the battle he realized that only physical evolution wasn't a solution, so his final mutation transformed Ralph into a being of pure undiluted thought and he left the planet for the higher plane of existence.

ralph rider.name: Ralph Rider
ralph rider.origin: Dr. Ralph Rider was an accomplished scientist. He lived on Long Island and owned one of the most impressive libraries of Physics books. At one point late in life, his brother Charles sent his eldest son Richard Rider (AKA the hero Nova) to stay with Ralph in the hopes of improving Richard's grades. Before Richard arrived, however, his uncle had been murdered by Photon in an attempt to steal one of Rider's inventions. Nova and Spider-Man investigated Ralph's murder. Ralph's other nephew Robert seems to have inherited his intelligence and aptitude towards science.

ralph roberts.name: Ralph Roberts
ralph roberts.origin: Ralph Roberts was a scientist who had been studying the effects of nuclear radiation involving the element of cobalt. He used to work at Stark Industries, but soon left due to his boss's refusal to share Iron Man technology with the military. After leaving Stark's company Ralph founded his own laboratory, with the goal of creating his own battle armor based on his observations of Iron Man in action which he planned to give to the military as opposed to his former boss. Upon completion, he called himself the Cobalt Man. When he first put on the suit, he was suffering from a concussion, because he had injured himself in a pole jump competition with his brother Ted. Because of his head injury, he became obsessed with defeating Iron Man. He was defeated by the X-Men before his unstable suit could explode. Ralph finally achieved superhuman size and power due to being bombarded with radiation. However, this was slowly killing him and he decided to show the world the dangers of nuclear power by destroying himself and the city of Sydney, Australia. He later seemingly died in a fight with the Hulk, when thrown safely away from the planet. The Cobalt Man resurfaced alive, having been brainwashed to serve Egghead as part of his Emissaries of Evil, and fought the Defenders. Roberts was believed to have been killed in a nuclear explosion while trying to kill Egghead. He later turned up alive battling the Hulk, who violently smashed him with a car. Roberts was imprisoned at Ryker's Island, but escaped and allied himself with a group of super-villains hiding out in Stamford, Connecticut. The New Warriors arrived to capture the villains, but one of them, Nitro, blew himself up killing most of the Warriors, 600 innocent civilians and, apparently, all of his fellow fugitives, including Roberts. Ralph seemingly returned from the dead, but it was later revealed this was really a Skrull impostor. When interrogated by Captain Marvel about the Skrulls' Secret Invasion plans, the Skrull told him that he was not the real Captain Marvel. One of Roberts' suits was acquired and modified by a distraught man seeking to reconcile with his girlfriend. The newly-named Cobalt Tomahawk tried to rob an Arizona reservation casino only to be stopped by the American Eagle. Later, a group of men wearing cheap knockoffs of the Cobalt Man suit attacked surviving New Warrior Speedball in retaliation for the Stamford massacre, calling themselves the Cobalt Men. During Hercules' journey to Hades, the Underworld, the Cobalt Man was seen gambling for his resurrection. He was later seen as a member of Pluto's jury alongside Nessus, Orka, the Armless Tiger Man, the Abomination, Jack O'Lantern, the Scourge of the Underworld, Baron Heinrich Zemo, Kyknos, Artume, and Veranke for Zeus' trial. Ralph Roberts was later resurrected and retired from villainy. He was forced back into action after being targeted by Umbral Dynamics for his radioactive suit. He was captured by the Mercs for Money and taken into Umbral Dynamics custody. Once the Mercs realized Umbral was actually evil, they stormed their headquarters in Bagalia and set free all the radioactive-based superhumans imprisoned there, including the Cobalt Man.

ralph ryder.name: Ralph Ryder
ralph ryder.origin: Dr. Ryder was an agent of A.I.M. who had infiltrated the anti-espionage agency S.H.I.E.L.D. Knowing that they had a traitor in their midst, Nick Fury was able to draw Ryder out by accusing Captain America of being the traitor and testing him out using the powerful "X-4" android built by Tony Stark, who was then the agency's chief weaponsmith. As expected, the traitor took the Captain's test by fire as an opportunity to assassinate him, and Ryder was caught in the act of operating the android via remote control by Sharon Carter.

ralph sorrell.name: Ralph Sorrell
ralph sorrell.origin: Ralph Sorrell took a drive out of Miami, while drunk. The drunk driver crashed into a bus in the middle of Man-Thing's Swamp, killing all 50 people on board except for four survivors. The survivors were Mary Brown, Jim Arsdale, Holden Crane, and a seriously-injured Kevin Kennerman. Ralph joined the group of survivors, who began to travel through the swamp. Their intention was to get to the closest town and get medical help for Kevin. When they thought they reached the town, Ralph turned on the rest of them because he was more concerned about being arrested for his drunk driving. He killed Jim and Holden before Man-Thing rescued Mary and Kevin. Ralph discovered a flamethrower in a nearby construction site. He attempted to use it to burn Man-Thing, but failed to kill him. Man-Thing struck back, grabbed him, and burned Ralph to death.

ralphie robot.name: Ralphie (Robot)
ralphie robot.origin: Ralphie was a robotic ally of Gears Garvin and the Midnight Wreckers. When deserting Baintronics employee Rahman Bashara approached the Wreckers' hideout to join them, Ralphie noticed him on the security camera screens. Afterwards he also alerted the Midnight Wreckers of a group of Bain robots who had trailed Dr. Bashara. Baintronics' attack on the hideout coincided with an assault from the A.I. Army, who wrongfully believed Gears of acting againt A.I. interests. Ralphie helped evacuate the robots from the hideout, and when Gears covered his escape, the A.I. Army soldiers opted to focus their attacks on the Bain-Robots since they noticed the humans were putting themselves in danger for the robots. After Bashara disabled the Bain-Robots, Ralphie returned to the hideout and convinced the A.I. Army soliders that their attack was misguided. Since their base had been exposed, Gears and his allies moved to a barn in Upstate New York. Soon afterwards, they were confronted again by the A.I. Army, this time led by an imposter of Gears' former ally Machine Man, who had just learned of the allegations against Garvin. During their encounter, Ralphie once again vouched for Gears.

rama kaliph.name: Rama Kaliph
rama kaliph.origin: Rama Kaliph was a magician and friend of Doctor Strange. While seeking the secret of Eternity, Doctor Strange sought out Kaliph's aid, but Baron Mordo had placed the Spell of Silence on Kaliph. He was called by Clea to assist Strange in a battle against Dormammu and lived as a guest in his Sanctum Sanctorum for a time. Kaliph was later killed by Silver Dagger. Kaliph had at least one student, Abu Ben Hakim.

ramades.name: Ramades
ramades.origin: At some point during his reign, Rama-Tut impregnated a slave woman who bore a son named Ramades, whom Rama-Tut abandoned. Ramades would eventually grow to adulthood in ancient Egypt and came to resent his father. Discovering the time travel technology left behind he became determined to succeed where his father had failed so many times: conquering the modern age. Ramades' scheme was foiled by the Fantastic Four.
